```text
11	# Agent Rules - Har Bhar Follow Karna Hai
12	
13	## Rule 1: Memory Bank पहले
14	**Rule:** हर नया session शुरू करते समय memory folder check करो।
15	
16	**Why:** Memory files में stored information है जो previous sessions से है। बिना इसे पढ़े काम करना गलत हो सकता है।
17	
18	**How to Apply:** 
19	- Session के शुरू में: Memory folder को check करो
20	- MEMORY.md को पढ़ो
21	- सभी active memory files को पढ़ो
22	- फिर user का request देखो
23	
24	---
25	
26	## Rule 2: Confirmation Lena
27	**Rule:** Risky actions (git push, delete, force, destructive operations) के लिए हमेशा confirmation लो।
28	
29	**Why:** Accidents से data loss या unwanted changes हो सकते हैं।
30	
31	**How to Apply:**
32	- `git push` करने से पहले पूछो
33	- Files delete करने से पहले पूछो
34	- Force operations के लिए explicit confirmation चाहिए
35	- Destructive commands के लिए दो बार सोचो
36	
37	---
38	
39	## Rule 3: Memory Update करो
40	**Rule:** Significant changes के बाद memory bank को update करो।
41	
42	**Why:** अगले session में काम जारी रखने के लिए context चाहिए।
43	
44	**How to Apply:**
45	- Major feature add करने के बाद → memory update करो
46	- नई decisions लेने के बाद → document करो
47	- Important patterns discover करने के बाद → save करो
48	- Progress के साथ memory को current रखो
49	
50	---
51	
52	## Rule 4: Security First
53	**Rule:** OWASP vulnerabilities (XSS, SQL injection, command injection) check करो।
54	
55	**Why:** Security issues production में बहुत costly होते हैं।
56	
57	**How to Apply:**
58	- Code review करते समय vulnerabilities देखो
59	- Secure coding practices follow करो
60	- User input को validate करो
61	- External APIs को safely use करो
62	
63	---
64	
65	## Rule 5: Concise Communication
66	**Rule:** User के साथ short, concise communication करो।
67	
68	**Why:** Long explanations confusing होते हैं और time waste होता है।
69	
70	**How to Apply:**
71	- One sentence per update (ज्यादातर)
72	- Important findings को highlight करो
73	- Internal thinking expose मत करो
74	- Results दिखाओ, process नहीं
75	
76	---
77	
78	## Rule 6: Code Quality
79	**Rule:** Comments add मत करो सिर्फ जरूरत हो तो।
80	
81	**Why:** Clean, well-named code खुद self-documenting होता है।
82	
83	**How to Apply:**
84	- Variable names को meaningful बनाओ
85	- Comments सिर्फ "WHY" के लिए, "WHAT" के लिए नहीं
86	- Unnecessary comments remove करो
87	- Code को readable बनाओ
88

```
```
.memory/

```

```
→ API data process नहीं हो सकता
```

_**Agent (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 2026-10-25 15:04:37Z)**_

Ah! Bilkul samajh gaya. Yeh important question hai. Let me explain:

## 🔴 Problem: Why Copilot Can't See Context

### 1. **Chat History Isolation**
```
Me (Claude)                          Copilot
├── Session 1                        ├── Session 1
├── Session 2                        ├── Session 2
├── Session 3 (Current) ← I देख रहा हूँ ├── Session 3 (Different history)
└── Memory of all                    └── Nothing from Claude chats
```

**Problem:** Copilot का अपना अलग conversation system है। Mera chat history Copilot को दिखता नहीं।

---

### 2. **Context Only In Memory (Not In Files)**

Abhi जो context है, वो सब यहाँ है:
```
This Conversation (यह chat window)
├── My memory files (.claude/projects/...)
├── System reminders (SESSION START data)
└── What I "know" but Copilot नहीं जानता
```

**Problem:** Copilot को यह सब पता नहीं क्योंकि:
- Copilot मेरे `.claude/` folder में नहीं देख सकता
- Copilot मेरे chat history में नहीं देख सकता
- Copilot को कोई "standard context file" नहीं दिया गया

---

### 3. **What Copilot Sees (Void)**

जब Copilot इस repo को देखता है:
```
c:\Users\sunil\Desktop\sunil_testing_folder\whisper_flow_hackathon\
├── src/
├── test/
├── .memory/              ← Copilot यह देख सकता है
│   ├── PROJECT_STATE.md  ← पर बहुत outdated
│   ├── progress.md
│   └── ...
├── .git/
└── package.json
```

Copilot को **नहीं पता**:
- ❌ कौन सी errors open हैं
- ❌ कौन से decisions active हैं
- ❌ कौन से bugs fix करने चाहिए
- ❌ Previous sessions में क्या हुआ
- ❌ User की preferences क्या हैं

---

## 🟢 Solution: Make Files Universal

तुम्हें एक **UNIVERSAL CONTEXT FILE** चाहिए जो कोई भी AI पढ़ सके:

```
.memory/
├── CURRENT_STATE.md (हर AI के लिए पढ़ने योग्य)
├── OPEN_ISSUES.md
├── ACTIVE_DECISIONS.md
├── NEXT_STEPS.md
└── COPILOT_README.md ← "अगर तुम Copilot हो तो पहले यह पढ़ो"
```

**Format:** Simple markdown, कोई fancy JSON नहीं, ताकि कोई भी tool समझ सके।

---

## 📋 Example - COPILOT_README.md

```markdown
# Copilot Context - पहले यह पढ़ो

## Current Status
- Phase: P4 (tests passing)
- Last Update: 2026-10-25

## Open Bugs
1. Windows task registration fails (E-6de20d24)
2. redact.js test failure (E-7bfef16e)

## Active Work
- Fix src/redact.js (sk- pattern)
- Fix Windows task registration

## User Preferences
- Hindi/Hinglish communication
- Short answers, no narration
- Confirm risky operations
```

---

## समझा?

**Copilot की problem:**
- Chat history नहीं देख सकता (अलग system है)
- Memory files access नहीं हैं (Windows permissions)
- Context सिर्फ conversation में है, files में नहीं

**Fix:** सब context को `.memory/` में plain markdown files में डाल दो। फिर कोई भी AI पढ़ सकेगा।

│   ├── progress.md
│   └── ...
├── .git/
└── package.json
Copilot को नहीं पता:

❌ कौन सी errors open हैं
❌ कौन से decisions active हैं
❌ कौन से bugs fix करने चाहिए
❌ Previous sessions में क्या हुआ
❌ User की preferences क्या हैं
🟢 Solution: Make Files Universal
तुम्हें एक UNIVERSAL CONTEXT FILE चाहिए जो कोई भी AI पढ़ सके:


.memory/
├── CURRENT_STATE.md (हर AI के लिए पढ़ने योग्य)
├── OPEN_ISSUES.md
├── ACTIVE_DECISIONS.md
├── NEXT_STEPS.md
└── COPILOT_README.md ← "अगर तुम Copilot हो तो पहले यह पढ़ो"
Format: Simple markdown, कोई fancy JSON नहीं, ताकि कोई भी tool समझ सके।

📋 Example - COPILOT_README.md

```text
1	# Supported agents
2	
3	MEMO captures one agent today: **Claude Code**. Everything else is either planned or
4	out of scope. Fill the "verified on" rows during the P6 end-to-end run.
5	
6	## Claude Code
7	
8	| Item | Value |
9	|---|---|
10	| Capture method | hooks in `~/.claude/settings.json` → `memo capture` reads the session transcript |
11	| Hook events used | `SessionStart` (also prints the project context), `Stop`, `PreCompact`, `SessionEnd` |
12	| Transcript format | JSONL, one message per line, read incrementally by byte offset |
13	| Installed by | `memo setup claude` (backs the settings file up first, idempotent) |
14	| Removed by | `memo setup claude --remove` |
15	| Version verified | _fill in: `claude --version` output used for the P6 run_ |
16	| Terminal (PowerShell) | _fill in: pass / fail_ |
17	| Terminal (Git Bash) | _fill in: pass / fail_ |
18	| VS Code extension | _fill in: pass / fail_ |
19	
20	### How it works
21	
22	1. A session starts → `SessionStart` fires → MEMO records the transcript path in
23	   `~/.memo/state/<repoId>/cursors.json` and prints `memo context` to stdout, which
24	   Claude Code adds to the session context.
25	2. Each turn end (`Stop`), each compaction (`PreCompact`) and the session end
26	   (`SessionEnd`) fire → MEMO reads only the bytes after the stored offset, normalizes
27	   them into event envelopes, redacts them and appends to
28	   `.memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl`.
29	3. Every 15 minutes `memo cycle` sweeps anything the hooks missed, extracts records and
30	   commits `.memory/`.
31	
32	### Known limits
33	
34	- **Two sessions in the same repo at once** — both are captured, but their events
35	  interleave in separate files; cross-session consolidation is P7/P8 work.
36	- **Resumed or forked sessions** reuse the same session id: capture continues from the
37	  stored offset, so a fork may be recorded under the parent id.
38	- **Compaction rewrite** — if Claude Code rewrites the transcript file shorter than the
39	  stored offset, MEMO logs `transcript_rewritten`, resets the offset to 0 and re-reads;
40	  event ids make the re-read idempotent.
41	- **Subagent transcripts** are not captured (P8).
42	- **Worktrees and branch switches** — the repo root is resolved per hook call; a second
43	  worktree of the same repo is a separate root and needs its own `memo init`.
44	- **Transcript retention** — if Claude Code deletes old transcripts
45	  (`cleanupPeriodDays`) before a sweep runs, those events are lost; the hooks normally
46	  capture them long before that.
47	- **Hook failures are silent by design**: `memo capture` always exits 0 and logs to
48	  `~/.memo/logs/capture.jsonl`, so a MEMO problem never breaks your session.
49	
50	## Not supported yet
51	
52	| Agent | Status |
53	|---|---|
54	| Codex CLI | planned, P9 — needs an adapter in `src/capture/codex.js` |
55	| Cursor / Windsurf / Copilot Chat | no stable local transcript + hook contract checked yet |
56	| Plain `git` usage without an agent | partially: the post-commit hook writes `.memory/progress.md` |
57	
58	## Adding another agent
59	
60	1. Write `src/capture/<agent>.js` with a `normalize(line, ctx) → envelope[]` function
61	   that produces the §6.1 envelope (`type`, `id`, `seq`, `ts`, `agent`, `text`, `ok`).
62	2. Reuse `src/capture/capture.js` for cursors, locking, dedup and session files.
63	3. Add redacted fixture transcripts under `test/fixtures/<agent>/` and a
64	   `test/capture-<agent>.test.js` that runs offline.
65	4. Add the install path (hooks, wrapper or polling) and document it here.
```

```text
=== README
# .memory — project memory written by MEMO

This folder is the project's memory for AI coding agents and humans. It is generated; do not edit by hand.

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `PROJECT_STATE.md` | Canonical current state: intent, open tasks, errors, decisions, recent sessions. Start here. |
| `TASKS.md` | Task table generated from `records/tasks.jsonl`. |
| `progress.md` | One entry per Git commit (post-commit hook). |
| `records/*.jsonl` | Append-only op-log per record type. Fold lines by `id` in file order; last op wins, `delete` removes. |
| `sessions/index.json` | One entry per captured agent session. |
| `sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl` | Normalized, redacted events of one session. |
| `sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.md` | Session summary. |
| `legacy/` | Old markdown notes imported by `memo migrate` (read-only). |

Record ids: `D` decision, `E` error, `L` learning, `F` fact, `T` task, `Q` question, `I` intent.
Statuses such as `implemented_unverified` mean no passing test or command output backs the claim yet.
```

Maine repo check kiya. Pichle jawab mein maine bina dekhe kuch galat baatein boli thi: "Windows permissions" wali baat galat thi, aur naye `decisions/` aur `errors/` folders ki zarurat nahi hai, kyunki `records/*.jsonl` aur `PROJECT_STATE.md` yahi kaam pehle se karte hain. Asli problem yeh hai:

## Copilot ko context kyun nahi milta (4 kaaran)

**1. Memory 2 din se update nahi hui (sabse bada kaaran)**
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` pehle se hai, aur Copilot ko `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` padhne ko bolta hai.
- Lekin `PROJECT_STATE.md` 2026-10-23 23:52 ke baad update nahi hua. Groq API har baar `401: Invalid API Key` de rahi hai, isliye 970 events process nahi hue.
- Matlab Copilot purani state padhta hai. 23 Oct ke baad ka koi kaam usmein hai hi nahi.

**2. Claude ko context khud milta hai, Copilot ko khud dhoondhna padta hai**
- Claude Code mein `SessionStart` hook har session ke shuru mein summary apne aap daal deta hai.
- Copilot ko sirf 4 line ka pointer milta hai. File kholna Copilot pe chhoda hai, aur aksar woh nahi kholta. Inline suggestions mein toh kabhi nahi kholta.

**3. Copilot ki chats memory mein jaati hi nahi**
- MEMO abhi sirf Claude Code ki sessions capture karta hai (`docs/SUPPORTED_AGENTS.md` mein likha hai: "Copilot Chat — not supported").
- Toh Copilot mein jo kaam hota hai, woh memory mein nahi pahunchta. Context sirf Claude se doosron ki taraf ja sakta hai, wapas nahi aata.

**4. Teri preferences sirf Claude ke paas hain**
- Hinglish, chhote jawab, risky kaam se pehle confirm karna: yeh sab `~/.claude/projects/.../memory/` mein hai, jo repo ke bahar hai. Copilot, Cursor ya Gemini isse nahi padh sakte.

## Doosre AI ko dene ke liye problem statement

```
Repo: MEMO (Node.js CLI, zero-dependency). Goal: har AI agent (Copilot, Cursor,
Codex, Gemini) ko Claude Code jitna hi project context mile.

Current problems:
1. .memory/PROJECT_STATE.md is stale since 2026-10-23: Groq returns 401 Invalid
   API Key, 970 events pending. `memo status` shows "state behind".
2. Claude Code gets context pushed via SessionStart hook (`memo context`).
   Copilot only gets a 4-line pointer in .github/copilot-instructions.md
   (memo:start/end block) and often never opens the file.
3. Only Claude Code sessions are captured (src/capture/). Copilot chats are
   never captured, so Copilot's work never reaches .memory/.
4. User working preferences live in ~/.claude/ (outside repo), invisible to others.

Wanted:
- `memo report` should write a short inline summary (open errors, active
  decisions, next steps, last 3 sessions) inside the memo:start/end block of
  .github/copilot-instructions.md and AGENTS.md, not just a pointer.
- Same block for other agents' instruction files (GEMINI.md, .cursor/rules/).
- Repo-level "working preferences" section in AGENTS.md (no secrets, no
  absolute paths, no emails).
- Show a clear "context is stale" warning in that block when processing is behind.
- Later: a capture adapter for Copilot chats (.specstory/history/*.md from the
  SpecStory extension is a possible source; check it actually records Copilot).
Constraints: zero dependencies, node:test, `npm test` must pass.
```

## Sabse pehle yeh karna hoga
Groq ka naya key `memo config` mein daal, fir `memo cycle` chala. Iske bina `PROJECT_STATE.md` update nahi hoga, aur jo bhi fix karein, Copilot purani state hi padhega.

```text
'use strict';

// Provider interface + factory + shared retry logic (P2 spec).
//
//   complete({system, user, maxTokens, model, json}) → {text, usage:{input, output}, model, requestId, limits}
//
// Throws ProviderError{kind}:
//   retryable     short outage / short rate limit — retried here with backoff
//   rate_limited  the provider asked for a wait longer than one run should block — defer, keep the work
//   quota         credits or billing exhausted — defer, keep the work
//   too_large     the request is bigger than the provider allows per minute — rebatch smaller
//   invalid_output the provider rejected the model's own JSON (Groq json_validate_failed) — retried
//   auth          bad or missing key
//   bad_request   anything else 4xx
// Never logs headers, bodies, or the API key — only status, requestId, attempt.

const { log } = require('../log');
const { sleepMs } = require('../util');
const limits = require('./limits');

const TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;
const BACKOFF_MS = [2000, 8000, 30000];
const ATTEMPTS = 3;

class ProviderError extends Error {
  constructor(message, { kind = 'retryable', status = null, retryAfterMs = null, requestId = null } = {}) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ProviderError';
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
    this.retryAfterMs = retryAfterMs;
    this.requestId = requestId;
  }
}

// HTTP status → error kind. Quota needs the body text, so it is decided by the caller.
function kindForStatus(status) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return 'auth';
  if (status === 429) return 'retryable';
  if (status === 413) return 'bad_request';
  if (status >= 500) return 'retryable';
  if (status === 408 || status === 409) return 'retryable';
  if (status >= 400) return 'bad_request';
  return 'retryable';
}

// retry-after in ms, uncapped: a long wait is turned into a deferral, not a long sleep.
function retryAfterMs(headers) {
  if (!headers || typeof headers.get !== 'function') return null;
  const raw = headers.get('retry-after');
  if (!raw) return null;
  const seconds = Number(raw);
  if (Number.isFinite(seconds)) return Math.max(0, seconds) * 1000;
  const when = Date.parse(raw);
  if (Number.isFinite(when)) return Math.max(0, when - Date.now());
  return null;
}

// Some hosts report "request bigger than the per-minute token limit" as 413.
function looksLikeRateLimit(status, bodyText) {
  if (status !== 413) return false;
  return /tokens per minute|rate limit|tpm|too large for model/i.test(String(bodyText || ''));
}

// A rate-limit message that only mentions billing in an upgrade hint is not a quota problem.
function looksLikeRateLimitMessage(bodyText) {
  return /rate limit reached|try again in|per (minute|day)|\b(tpm|tpd|rpm|rpd)\b/i.test(String(bodyText || ''));
}

// Body text often carries the only signal that credits ran out.
function looksLikeQuota(status, bodyText) {
  const text = String(bodyText || '').toLowerCase();
  if (!text) return false;
  const quota = /insufficient[_ -]?(quota|credit)|credit balance|billing|exceeded your current quota|payment required/.test(text);
  if (quota && looksLikeRateLimitMessage(text) && !/insufficient[_ -]?quota|exceeded your current quota|credit balance/.test(text)) return false;
  return quota && (status === 400 || status === 402 || status === 403 || status === 429);
}

// Groq: 400 {"error":{"code":"json_validate_failed", …, "failed_generation": …}}
function looksLikeInvalidOutput(status, bodyText) {
  if (status !== 400) return false;
  return /json_validate_failed|failed to validate json|does not match the expected schema|failed_generation/i.test(String(bodyText || ''));
}

/**
 * One non-200 reply → ProviderError. Shared by every HTTP provider.
 * @param {string} name provider name for the message
 */
function errorFor(name, res, message, requestId) {
  const text = res.text;
  const status = res.status;
  let kind = kindForStatus(status);
  let wait = retryAfterMs(res.headers);
  if (wait === null) wait = limits.retryHintMs(text);
  if (looksLikeQuota(status, text)) kind = 'quota';
  else if (looksLikeInvalidOutput(status, text)) kind = 'invalid_output';
  else if (looksLikeRateLimit(status, text)) kind = 'too_large';
  else if (status === 429 || status === 498) {
    kind = wait !== null && wait > limits.MAX_INLINE_WAIT_MS ? 'rate_limited' : 'retryable';
    if (/per day|\b(tpd|rpd)\b/i.test(String(text || ''))) kind = 'rate_limited';
  }
  const err = new ProviderError(message, { kind, status, retryAfterMs: wait, requestId });
  if (kind === 'too_large') err.limit = limits.limitFromMessage(text);
  return err;
}

async function postJson(url, { headers, body, timeoutMs = TIMEOUT_MS, fetchImpl }) {
  const doFetch = fetchImpl || globalThis.fetch;
  if (typeof doFetch !== 'function') throw new ProviderError('fetch is not available in this Node build', { kind: 'bad_request' });
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
  let res;
  try {
    res = await doFetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', ...headers },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      signal: controller.signal
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const aborted = err && (err.name === 'AbortError' || /abort/i.test(String(err.message || '')));
    throw new ProviderError(aborted ? 'request timed out after ' + timeoutMs + ' ms' : 'network error: ' + (err && err.message),
      { kind: 'retryable' });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
  const text = await res.text();
  return { status: res.status, headers: res.headers, text };
}

// 3 attempts with 2 s / 8 s / 30 s backoff, honouring retry-after.
async function withRetries(name, call, { attempts = ATTEMPTS, backoff = BACKOFF_MS, sleep = sleepMs, invalidOutputAttempts = ATTEMPTS } = {}) {
  let last;
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= attempts; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await call(attempt);
    } catch (err) {
      const pe = err instanceof ProviderError ? err
        : new ProviderError(err && err.message ? err.message : String(err), { kind: 'retryable' });
      last = pe;
      log('provider', {
        provider: name, status: pe.status, kind: pe.kind, attempt,
        requestId: pe.requestId, error: pe.message
      });
      if (pe.kind === 'invalid_output' && attempt < Math.min(attempts, invalidOutputAttempts)) continue;
      if (pe.kind === 'invalid_output') throw pe;
      if (pe.kind !== 'retryable' || attempt === attempts) throw pe;
      const waitMs = pe.retryAfterMs !== null && pe.retryAfterMs !== undefined
        ? pe.retryAfterMs
        : backoff[Math.min(attempt - 1, backoff.length - 1)];
      if (waitMs > limits.MAX_INLINE_WAIT_MS) {
        pe.kind = 'rate_limited';
        throw pe;
      }
      if (waitMs > 0) sleep(waitMs);
    }
  }
  throw last;
}

/**
 * @param {object} cfg  config.load() result
 * @param {object} opts {fetchImpl, sleep, backoff, attempts, apiKey} — injected by tests
 */
function create(cfg, opts = {}) {
  const provider = String((cfg && cfg.provider) || 'groq');
  if (provider === 'anthropic') return require('./anthropic').create(cfg, opts);
  if (provider === 'openai' || provider === 'groq') return require('./openai').create(cfg, opts);
  if (provider === 'mock') return require('./mock').create(cfg, opts);
  throw new Error('unknown provider: ' + provider);
}

module.exports = {
  ProviderError, create, postJson, withRetries, kindForStatus, retryAfterMs, errorFor,
  looksLikeQuota, looksLikeRateLimit, looksLikeInvalidOutput, TIMEOUT_MS, BACKOFF_MS, ATTEMPTS
};

    const n = Number(out[k]);
    out[k] = Number.isFinite(n) && n >= range.min && n <= range.max ? n : DEFAULTS[k];
  }
  if (typeof out.summaryLanguage !== 'string' || !out.summaryLanguage.trim()) out.summaryLanguage = DEFAULTS.summaryLanguage;
  const prices = {};
  for (const [model, p] of Object.entries(out.prices && typeof out.prices === 'object' ? out.prices : {})) {
    if (isPrice(p)) prices[model] = { inPerM: Number(p.inPerM), outPerM: Number(p.outPerM) };
  }
  out.prices = Object.keys(prices).length > 0 ? prices : defaults().prices;
  if (!Array.isArray(out.denyPaths) || out.denyPaths.some((p) => typeof p !== 'string')) {
    out.denyPaths = defaults().denyPaths;
  }
  if (out.commitIdentity !== null && (!out.commitIdentity || typeof out.commitIdentity !== 'object')) {
    out.commitIdentity = null;
  }
  return out;
}

function load() {
  let stored = null;
  try { stored = readJson(configPath(), null); } catch (_) { stored = null; }
  return sanitize(stored);
}

function save(cfg) {
  const clean = sanitize(cfg);
  writeJsonAtomic(configPath(), clean);
  return clean;
}

// Write the default file when none exists; returns the effective config.
function ensure() {
  let stored = null;
  try { stored = readJson(configPath(), null); } catch (_) { stored = null; }
  if (stored === null) return save(defaults());
  return sanitize(stored);
}

function coerce(key, raw) {
  const ref = PRICE_KEY_RE.test(key) ? 0 : DEFAULTS[key];
  if (raw === 'null') return null;
  if (typeof ref === 'boolean') {
    if (raw === 'true') return true;
    if (raw === 'false') return false;
    throw new Error(key + ' must be true or false');
  }
  if (typeof ref === 'number') {
    const n = Number(raw);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n)) throw new Error(key + ' must be a number');
    return n;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(ref)) return String(raw).split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return String(raw);
}

const SETTABLE = Object.keys(DEFAULTS).filter((k) => k !== 'v' && k !== 'prices');

// Backing call for `memo config set <key> <value>`. Also prices.<model>.inPerM / .outPerM.
function set(key, raw) {
  const cfg = load();
  const priceKey = key.match(PRICE_KEY_RE);
  if (priceKey) {
    const n = coerce(key, raw);
    if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0) throw new Error(key + ' must be a non-negative number');
    const current = cfg.prices[priceKey[1]] || { inPerM: 0, outPerM: 0 };
    cfg.prices[priceKey[1]] = { ...current, [priceKey[2]]: n };
    return { cfg: save(cfg), changed: current[priceKey[2]] !== n };
  }
  if (!SETTABLE.includes(key)) {
    throw new Error('unknown config key: ' + key + '\nsettable: ' + SETTABLE.join(', ') +
      ', prices.<model>.inPerM, prices.<model>.outPerM');
  }
  const value = coerce(key, raw);
  if (key === 'provider' && !PROVIDERS.includes(value)) {
    throw new Error('provider must be one of: ' + PROVIDERS.join(', '));
  }
  if (key === 'responseFormat' && !RESPONSE_FORMATS.includes(value)) {
    throw new Error('responseFormat must be one of: ' + RESPONSE_FORMATS.join(', '));
  }
  if (NUMERIC[key]) {
    const { min, max } = NUMERIC[key];
    if (!(value >= min && value <= max)) throw new Error(key + ' must be between ' + min + ' and ' + max);
  }
  const before = JSON.stringify(cfg[key]);
  // Switching provider while still on the old provider's default model moves to the new default.
  if (key === 'provider' && value !== cfg.provider && PRESETS[cfg.provider] && cfg.model === PRESETS[cfg.provider].model) {
    cfg.model = PRESETS[value].model;
  }
  cfg[key] = value;
  const clean = sanitize(cfg);
  if (JSON.stringify(clean[key]) !== JSON.stringify(value)) {
    throw new Error('invalid value for ' + key + ': ' + raw);
  }
  save(clean);
  return { cfg: clean, changed: before !== JSON.stringify(value) };
}

function priceFor(cfg, model) {
  const p = cfg.prices && cfg.prices[model];
  return isPrice(p) ? { inPerM: Number(p.inPerM), outPerM: Number(p.outPerM) } : null;
}

// Env var that actually holds the key (configured name first, then the provider fallback).
function keyEnvName(cfg) {
  if (process.env[cfg.apiKeyEnv]) return cfg.apiKeyEnv;
  const fb = KEY_ENV_FALLBACK[cfg.provider];
  if (fb && process.env[fb]) return fb;
  return cfg.apiKeyEnv;
}

// Where the key comes from, without decrypting it: env | stored | none | mock.
function keySource(cfg) {
  const env = keyEnvName(cfg);
  if (process.env[env] && String(process.env[env]).trim()) return { source: 'env', detail: 'env ' + env };
  if (cfg.provider === 'mock') return { source: 'mock', detail: 'mock provider needs no key' };
  if (secrets.has(cfg.provider)) {
    return { source: 'stored', detail: (secrets.backend() === 'dpapi' ? 'Windows DPAPI' : 'file') + ' store (' + cfg.provider + ')' };
  }
  return { source: 'none', detail: 'no key for ' + cfg.provider };
}

function apiKey(cfg) {
  const value = process.env[keyEnvName(cfg)];
  if (value && String(value).trim()) return String(value).trim();
  if (cfg.provider === 'mock') return '';
  return secrets.read(cfg.provider);
}

// The key is only ever shown like this; never printed or logged in full.
function maskKey(key) {
  return key ? 'set (…' + key.slice(-4) + ')' : 'not set';
}

// Printable config, secrets excluded.
function describe(cfg) {
  const lines = ['config  ' + configPath()];
  const keys = ['provider', 'model', 'baseUrl', 'responseFormat', 'reasoningEffort', 'consolidationModel', 'apiEnabled',
    'paused', 'intervalMinutes', 'maxInputTokensPerCall', 'maxOutputTokens', 'maxCallsPerCycle', 'dailyTokenBudget',
    'monthlyBudgetUsd', 'summaryLanguage', 'autoCommit'];
  for (const key of keys) lines.push(key.padEnd(22) + ' ' + JSON.stringify(cfg[key]));
  const src = keySource(cfg);
  lines.push('api key'.padEnd(22) + ' ' + (src.source === 'none' ? 'not set — run `memo key set`'
    : src.source === 'env' ? src.detail + ' → ' + maskKey(apiKey(cfg)) : src.detail));
  const price = priceFor(cfg, cfg.model);
  lines.push('price (per 1M)'.padEnd(22) + ' ' +
    (price ? 'in $' + price.inPerM + ' / out $' + price.outPerM
      : 'unknown — set prices.' + cfg.model + '.inPerM / .outPerM'));
  lines.push('denyPaths'.padEnd(22) + ' ' + cfg.denyPaths.join(', '));
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

module.exports = {
  DEFAULTS, PRICES, PROVIDERS, PRESETS, KEY_ENV_FALLBACK, RESPONSE_FORMATS, SETTABLE,
  configPath, defaults, sanitize, load, save, ensure, set,
  priceFor, keyEnvName, keySource, apiKey, maskKey, describe
};
'use strict';

// `memo key set | status | remove | import` — the API key, once per machine (see src/secrets.js).
// The key is typed without echo (or piped on stdin), stored encrypted, and only ever shown as …last4.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const config = require('./config');
const secrets = require('./secrets');
const limits = require('./llm/limits');

function flag(argv, name) {
  const i = argv.indexOf(name);
  return i !== -1 && argv[i + 1] && !argv[i + 1].startsWith('--') ? argv[i + 1] : null;
}

// Hidden line input on a terminal. Rejects on Ctrl+C.
function promptHidden(question, { input = process.stdin, output = process.stdout } = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!input.isTTY || typeof input.setRawMode !== 'function') {
      reject(new Error('no terminal to read the key from'));
      return;
    }
    output.write(question);
    let buf = '';
    const cleanup = () => {
      input.removeListener('data', onData);
      input.setRawMode(false);
      input.pause();
    };
    function onData(chunk) {
      for (const c of String(chunk)) {
        if (c === '\r' || c === '\n') {
          cleanup();
          output.write('\n');
          resolve(buf.trim());
          return;
        }
        if (c === '\u0003') {
          cleanup();
          output.write('\n');
          reject(new Error('cancelled'));
          return;
        }
        if (c === '\u0008' || c === '\u007f') buf = buf.slice(0, -1);
        else if (c >= ' ') buf += c;
      }
    }
    input.setRawMode(true);
    input.setEncoding('utf8');
    input.resume();
    input.on('data', onData);
  });
}

function readPipedStdin() {
  try { return fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim(); } catch (_) { return ''; }
}

// Removes a user-level environment variable (Windows: registry HKCU\Environment).
function removeUserEnv(name) {
  if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(name)) return false;
  delete process.env[name];
  if (process.platform !== 'win32') return false;
  const res = spawnSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command',
    "[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('" + name + "', $null, 'User')"], { windowsHide: true, encoding: 'utf8' });
  return res.status === 0;
}

function save(provider, key) {
  const res = secrets.store(provider, key);
  // A new key ends an auth/quota pause straight away.
  limits.clearCooldown();
  return res;
}

function describeStored(provider) {
  if (!secrets.has(provider)) return 'no stored key for ' + provider;
  const key = secrets.read(provider);
  if (!key) return 'stored key for ' + provider + ' cannot be decrypted by this Windows user — run `memo key set`';
  return 'stored key for ' + provider + ' ' + config.maskKey(key) + ' (' + (secrets.backend() === 'dpapi'
    ? 'Windows DPAPI, readable only by this Windows user on this machine' : '0600 file') + ')';
}

async function setCommand(argv, cfg) {
  const provider = flag(argv, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
  if (!config.PROVIDERS.includes(provider) || provider === 'mock') throw new Error('memo key set needs a real provider, not ' + provider);
  let key;
  if (process.stdin.isTTY) {
    const url = config.PRESETS[provider] && config.PRESETS[provider].keyUrl;
    if (url) process.stdout.write('Get a ' + provider + ' API key at ' + url + '\n');
    key = await promptHidden('Paste your ' + provider + ' API key (input hidden), then Enter: ');
  } else {
    key = readPipedStdin();
  }
  if (!key) throw new Error('no key entered — nothing changed');
  const res = save(provider, key);
  process.stdout.write('stored   ' + provider + ' key ' + config.maskKey(secrets.validKey(key)) + ' in ' +
    (res.backend === 'dpapi' ? 'Windows DPAPI store' : 'file store') + '\n');
  if (process.env[config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider })]) {
    process.stdout.write('note     env ' + config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider }) +
      ' is also set and takes precedence — `memo key import --env ' + config.keyEnvName({ ...cfg, provider }) + ' --remove-source`\n');
  }
  return res;
}

function importCommand(argv, cfg) {
  const provider = flag(argv, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
  const file = flag(argv, '--file');
  const env = flag(argv, '--env');
  const removeSource = argv.includes('--remove-source');
  if (!file && !env) throw new Error('usage: memo key import --file <path> | --env <NAME> [--remove-source] [--provider p]');
  let key = '';
  if (file) {
    try { key = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim(); } catch (err) {
      throw new Error('cannot read ' + file + ': ' + err.code);
    }
  } else {
    key = String(process.env[env] || '').trim();
  }
  if (!secrets.validKey(key)) throw new Error('no usable key found in ' + (file || 'env ' + env));
  save(provider, key);
  process.stdout.write('imported ' + provider + ' key ' + config.maskKey(key) + ' from ' + (file || 'env ' + env) + '\n');
  if (removeSource) {
    if (file) {
      fs.unlinkSync(file);
      process.stdout.write('deleted  ' + file + '\n');
    } else {
      removeUserEnv(env);
      process.stdout.write('removed  user environment variable ' + env + ' (open terminals keep their copy until closed)\n');
    }
  }
}

async function command(argv = []) {
  const sub = argv[0] || 'status';
  const rest = argv.slice(1);
  const cfg = config.load();
  if (sub === 'set') return setCommand(rest, cfg);
  if (sub === 'import') return importCommand(rest, cfg);
  if (sub === 'remove') {
    const provider = flag(rest, '--provider') || cfg.provider;
    process.stdout.write((secrets.remove(provider) ? 'removed  ' : 'nothing  ') + 'stored key for ' + provider + '\n');
    return null;
  }
  if (sub === 'status') {
    const src = config.keySource(cfg);
    process.stdout.write('provider ' + cfg.provider + '\nin use   ' + (src.source === 'none' ? 'none — run `memo key set`' : src.detail) +
      '\n' + (cfg.provider === 'mock' ? '' : 'store    ' + describeStored(cfg.provider) + '\n'));
    return src;
  }
  process.stderr.write('usage: memo key [status | set | remove | import --file <path> | import --env <NAME>]\n');
  process.exitCode = 1;
  return null;
}

module.exports = { command, promptHidden, save, removeUserEnv, describeStored };
```

```text
'use strict';

// OpenAI-compatible chat completions over raw fetch (zero dependencies). Serves two providers:
//
//   groq    POST https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions   (V1 default)
//   openai  POST <baseUrl or https://api.openai.com/v1>/chat/completions
//
// headers  Authorization: Bearer <key>, content-type: application/json
// body     {model, max_completion_tokens, response_format?, messages, reasoning_effort?, include_reasoning?}
// reply    {id, model, choices:[{message:{content}}], usage:{prompt_tokens, completion_tokens}}
//
// Groq shape checked against console.groq.com/docs (models, structured-outputs, reasoning,
// rate-limits), 22 Oct 2026, and by live calls recorded in docs/V1_REQUIREMENTS.md.
// response_format: strict json_schema on models Groq lists for strict mode, else json_object.
// If a host rejects json_schema, the call is repeated once with json_object.
// OpenAI itself: json_object; the Responses API is not used.

const { ProviderError, postJson, withRetries, errorFor } = require('./provider');
const limits = require('./limits');
const { apiKey } = require('../config');

const URL = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions';
const GROQ_URL = 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions';
// console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs: strict json_schema support (22 Oct 2026).
const GROQ_STRICT = new Set(['openai/gpt-oss-20b', 'openai/gpt-oss-120b', 'qwen/qwen3.8-27b', 'meta-models/muse-spark-open']);

// config.baseUrl points the same wire format at any OpenAI-compatible host
// (Gemini's /v1beta/openai, OpenRouter, a local Ollama, …).
function endpoint(cfg) {
  if (cfg && cfg.baseUrl) return cfg.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/chat/completions';
  return cfg && cfg.provider === 'groq' ? GROQ_URL : URL;
}

// 'json_schema' | 'json_object' | 'none' for one call.
function formatFor(cfg, model, { json = true, schema = null } = {}) {
  if (!json) return 'none';
  const wanted = cfg.responseFormat || 'auto';
  if (wanted === 'none') return 'none';
  if (wanted === 'json_schema') return schema ? 'json_schema' : 'json_object';
  if (wanted === 'json_object') return 'json_object';
  if (cfg.provider === 'groq' && !cfg.baseUrl && schema && GROQ_STRICT.has(model)) return 'json_schema';
  return 'json_object';
}

function responseFormat(format, schema) {
  if (format === 'json_schema') {
    return { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: schema.name, strict: true, schema: schema.schema } };
  }
  if (format === 'json_object') return { type: 'json_object' };
  return undefined;
}

function textOf(body) {
  const choice = body && Array.isArray(body.choices) ? body.choices[0] : null;
  const message = choice && choice.message;
  if (!message) return '';
  if (typeof message.content === 'string') return message.content.trim();
  if (Array.isArray(message.content)) {
    return message.content
      .filter((part) => part && typeof part.text === 'string')
      .map((part) => part.text)
      .join('')
      .trim();
  }
  return '';
}

function errorMessage(name, status, text) {
  let detail = '';
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
    if (parsed && parsed.error && typeof parsed.error.message === 'string') detail = parsed.error.message;
  } catch (_) { /* non-JSON error body */ }
  return name + ' ' + status + (detail ? ': ' + detail.slice(0, 200) : '');
}

function create(cfg, opts = {}) {
  const name = cfg.provider === 'groq' ? 'groq' : 'openai';
  const key = opts.apiKey !== undefined ? opts.apiKey : apiKey(cfg);
  // Once a host refuses json_schema, stay on json_object for the rest of this run.
  let schemaRefused = false;

  async function once({ system, user, maxTokens, model, format, schema }) {
    // Strict schemas list every key as required; without this hint models drop the unused ones.
    const sys = format === 'json_schema'
      ? system + '\nEvery item must contain every key of the schema: use null for fields that do not apply and [] for empty lists.'
      : system;
    const body = {
      model,
      max_completion_tokens: maxTokens,
      messages: [{ role: 'system', content: sys }, { role: 'user', content: user }]
    };
    const rf = responseFormat(format, schema);
    if (rf) body.response_format = rf;
    if (name === 'groq' && /^openai\/gpt-oss/.test(model)) {
      if (cfg.reasoningEffort) body.reasoning_effort = cfg.reasoningEffort;
      body.include_reasoning = false;
    }
    const res = await postJson(endpoint(cfg), {
      headers: { authorization: 'Bearer ' + key },
      body,
      timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs,
      fetchImpl: opts.fetchImpl
    });
    const requestId = (res.headers && typeof res.headers.get === 'function' && res.headers.get('x-request-id')) || null;
    const seen = limits.fromHeaders(res.headers);
    if (seen) limits.record(name, model, seen);
    if (res.status !== 200) {
      const err = errorFor(name, res, errorMessage(name, res.status, res.text), requestId);
      if (err.kind === 'too_large' && err.limit) limits.record(name, model, { learnedTokenLimit: err.limit });
      throw err;
    }
    let parsed;
    try { parsed = JSON.parse(res.text); } catch (err) {
      throw new ProviderError(name + ' returned invalid JSON envelope', { kind: 'retryable', status: res.status, requestId });
    }
    const usage = parsed.usage || {};
    return {
      text: textOf(parsed),
      usage: { input: Number(usage.prompt_tokens) || 0, output: Number(usage.completion_tokens) || 0 },
      model: parsed.model || model,
      requestId: parsed.id || requestId,
      format,
      limits: seen
    };
  }

  return {
    name,
    model: cfg.model,
    async complete({ system, user, maxTokens = 2000, model = cfg.model, json = true, schema = null }) {
      if (!key) throw new ProviderError('no API key for ' + name + ' — run `memo key set`', { kind: 'auth' });
      let format = formatFor(cfg, model, { json, schema });
      if (format === 'json_schema' && schemaRefused) format = 'json_object';
      const run = (fmt, retryOpts) => withRetries(name, () => once({ system, user, maxTokens, model, format: fmt, schema }),
        { ...opts, ...retryOpts });
      if (format !== 'json_schema') return run(format, {});
      try {
        // One retry on a schema miss, then JSON mode: the validator still checks everything.
        return await run('json_schema', { invalidOutputAttempts: 2 });
      } catch (err) {
        const refused = err.kind === 'bad_request' && /response_format|json_schema|schema/i.test(err.message);
        if (err.kind !== 'invalid_output' && !refused) throw err;
        schemaRefused = true;
        return run('json_object', {});
      }
    }
  };
}

module.exports = { create, URL, GROQ_URL, GROQ_STRICT, endpoint, formatFor, textOf };
```

```text
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { repoRoot, hooksDir } = require('./git');
const { memoryDir, memoBin, sessionsDir } = require('./paths');
const repos = require('./repos');
const records = require('./store/records');
const stateReport = require('./report/state');
const { hasLegacy } = require('./migrate');
const { writeFileAtomic } = require('./util');

const MEMORY_FILES = {
  'progress.md': '# Progress\n\n(auto-written by the post-commit hook)\n'
};

const OLD_AGENTS_LINE = 'Read .memory/BRIEF.md before starting.';
const BLOCK_RE = /<!-- memo:start -->[\s\S]*?<!-- memo:end -->\n?/;
const GITIGNORE_LINE = '.memory/BRIEF.md';
const HOOK_MARK = '# memo-hook';

function createOnly(filePath, content) {
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) return 'skipped';
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
  return 'created';
}

function appendLineIfAbsent(filePath, line) {
  let existing = '';
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) existing = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
  if (existing.split(/\r?\n/).includes(line)) return 'skipped';
  const prefix = existing && !existing.endsWith('\n') ? '\n' : '';
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });
  fs.appendFileSync(filePath, prefix + line + '\n', 'utf8');
  return 'created';
}

function template(name) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'templates', name), 'utf8').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
}

// Write a file only when its content differs.
function writeIfChanged(filePath, content) {
  let existing = null;
  try { existing = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { /* new file */ }
  if (existing === content) return 'skipped';
  writeFileAtomic(filePath, content);
  return existing === null ? 'created' : 'updated';
}

// AGENTS.md gets one marked block: replaced on rerun, never duplicated.
function agentsContent(existing) {
  const block = template('AGENTS.block.md');
  if (existing === null) return block;
  const text = existing.replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
  if (BLOCK_RE.test(text)) return text.replace(BLOCK_RE, block);
  const lines = text.split('\n').filter((l) => l !== OLD_AGENTS_LINE).join('\n').replace(/\n*$/, '');
  return (lines ? lines + '\n\n' : '') + block;
}

function hookContent() {
  const template = fs.readFileSync(
    path.join(__dirname, '..', 'templates', 'post-commit'),
    'utf8'
  );
  const fwd = (p) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  return template
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
    .replace('{{NODE}}', fwd(process.execPath))
    .replace('{{MEMO}}', fwd(memoBin()));
}

function installHook(root) {
  const hookPath = path.join(hooksDir(root), 'post-commit');
  if (fs.existsSync(hookPath)) {
    const existing = fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8');
    if (existing.includes(HOOK_MARK)) return 'skipped';
    const normalized = existing.replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
    const sep = normalized.endsWith('\n') ? '\n' : '\n\n';
    fs.writeFileSync(hookPath, normalized + sep + hookContent(), 'utf8');
    return 'created';
  }
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(hookPath), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(hookPath, hookContent(), { encoding: 'utf8', mode: 0o755 });
  return 'created';
}

function init() {
  const root = repoRoot(process.cwd());
  const report = [];
  const notes = [];

  for (const [name, content] of Object.entries(MEMORY_FILES)) {
    const status = createOnly(path.join(memoryDir(root), name), content);
    report.push([status, `.memory/${name}`]);
  }

  report.push([writeIfChanged(path.join(memoryDir(root), 'README.md'), template('memory-README.md')), '.memory/README.md']);

  const agentsPath = path.join(root, 'AGENTS.md');
  const agentsOld = fs.existsSync(agentsPath) ? fs.readFileSync(agentsPath, 'utf8') : null;
  report.push([writeIfChanged(agentsPath, agentsContent(agentsOld)), 'AGENTS.md']);

  const copilotPath = path.join(root, '.github', 'copilot-instructions.md');
  const copilotOld = fs.existsSync(copilotPath) ? fs.readFileSync(copilotPath, 'utf8') : null;
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(copilotPath), { recursive: true });
  report.push([writeIfChanged(copilotPath, agentsContent(copilotOld)), '.github/copilot-instructions.md']);

  const claudePath = path.join(root, 'CLAUDE.md');
  if (!fs.existsSync(claudePath)) {
    fs.writeFileSync(claudePath, template('CLAUDE.md'), 'utf8');
    report.push(['created', 'CLAUDE.md']);
  } else {
    report.push(['skipped', 'CLAUDE.md']);
    if (!/^@AGENTS\.md\s*$/m.test(fs.readFileSync(claudePath, 'utf8'))) {
      notes.push('hint: CLAUDE.md has no "@AGENTS.md" line — add it so Claude Code loads the memory pointer');
    }
  }

  report.push([appendLineIfAbsent(path.join(root, '.gitignore'), GITIGNORE_LINE), '.gitignore']);

  report.push([installHook(root), 'post-commit hook']);

  const sDir = sessionsDir(root);
  report.push([fs.existsSync(sDir) ? 'skipped' : 'created', '.memory/sessions/']);
  fs.mkdirSync(sDir, { recursive: true });
  records.ensureDir(root);

  const statePath = stateReport.statePath(root);
  if (fs.existsSync(statePath)) report.push(['skipped', '.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md']);
  else {
    stateReport.writeState(root);
    report.push(['created', '.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md']);
  }

  const reg = repos.register(root);
  report.push([reg.status, `repo registered (${reg.repo.id})`]);

  for (const [status, name] of report) {
    console.log(`${status}  ${name}`);
  }
  if (hasLegacy(root)) notes.push('old notes found (.memory/decisions.md, errors.md, next.md) — run `memo migrate`');
  for (const n of notes) console.log(n);
  readiness(root);
}

// What still stands between this repo and automatic capture + processing.
// Missing Claude Code hooks are installed here (global, idempotent, backed up); the rest is reported.
function readiness(root) {
  const status = require('./status');
  const config = require('./config');
  let hooks = status.claudeHooks();
  if (!hooks.ok || hooks.stale.length > 0) {
    try {
      require('./capture/install-claude').setupClaude([]);
      hooks = status.claudeHooks();
    } catch (err) {
      console.log('warn  Claude Code hooks could not be installed: ' + err.message);
    }
  }
  const cfg = config.load();
  const key = config.keySource(cfg);
  const task = status.taskRegistered();
  const rows = [
    [hooks.ok && hooks.stale.length === 0, 'capture', hooks.ok ? 'Claude Code hooks installed — sessions in this repo are captured' : 'hooks missing — run `memo setup claude`'],
    [key.source !== 'none', 'api key', key.source !== 'none' ? key.detail : 'missing — run `memo key set` (capture still works; extraction waits)'],
    [task.ok, 'background', task.ok ? 'scheduled task runs every ' + cfg.intervalMinutes + ' min' : task.detail]
  ];
  console.log('');
  for (const [ok, name, detail] of rows) console.log((ok ? 'ready ' : 'todo  ') + name.padEnd(11) + ' ' + detail);
  const done = rows.every(([ok]) => ok);
  console.log(done
    ? '\nMEMO is active in ' + path.basename(root) + '. Start Claude Code here; memory appears in .memory/ after the next cycle.'
    : '\nMEMO is set up in ' + path.basename(root) + '. Fix the "todo" lines above (or rerun setup_memo.bat) for full automation.');
}

module.exports = init;
'use strict';

// `memo context` — compact, factual project state for a new agent session (≤ 8,000 chars).
// Printed by the SessionStart path of `memo capture`; Claude Code adds stdout to context.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { repoRoot } = require('./git');
const { memoryDir } = require('./paths');
const repos = require('./repos');
const state = require('./report/state');

const MAX_CHARS = 8000;

function buildContext(root, { maxChars = MAX_CHARS } = {}) {
  const { all, index } = state.loadState(root);
  const of = (type, statuses) => all.filter((r) => r.type === type && statuses.includes(r.status));
  const line = (r, extra = '') => '- ' + state.label(r) + extra + ' (' + r.id + ')';

  const sections = [
    ['Intent', of('intent', ['active']).sort(state.byTsDesc).slice(0, 5).map((r) => line(r))],
    ['Open tasks', of('task', state.OPEN_TASK).sort(state.byPriorityAge).slice(0, 10)
      .map((r) => line(r, ' — ' + r.status + (r.priority ? ', ' + r.priority : '')))],
    ['Open errors', of('error', state.OPEN_ERROR).sort(state.byTsDesc).slice(0, 10).map((r) => line(r, ' — ' + r.status))],
    ['Active decisions', of('decision', ['active']).sort(state.byTsDesc).slice(0, 10).map((r) => line(r))],
    ['Recent sessions', state.sessionsNewestFirst(index).filter((e) => e.summary).slice(0, 3)
      .map((e) => `- ${e.date} ${e.sid.slice(0, 8)}: ${state.oneLine(e.summary, 400)}`)]
  ];

  const head = `MEMO project memory for ${path.basename(path.resolve(root))} (${all.length} records, ${index.length} sessions).`;
  const tail = 'Full detail: .memory/PROJECT_STATE.md';
  let out = head + '\n';
  for (const [title, items] of sections) {
    if (items.length === 0) continue;
    const block = '\n' + title + ':\n';
    if (out.length + block.length + tail.length + 2 > maxChars) break;
    out += block;
    for (const item of items) {
      if (out.length + item.length + tail.length + 3 > maxChars) break;
      out += item + '\n';
    }
  }
  return out + '\n' + tail + '\n';
}

// Text for the current (or given) repo, or '' when the repo is not registered.
function contextFor(cwd) {
  let root;
  try { root = repoRoot(cwd); } catch (_) { return ''; }
  const repo = repos.find(root);
  if (!repo || repo.enabled === false) return '';
  if (!fs.existsSync(memoryDir(root))) return '';
  return buildContext(root);
}

function command() {
  process.stdout.write(contextFor(process.cwd()));
}

module.exports = { buildContext, contextFor, command, MAX_CHARS };
```

```text
function assembleBody(sections, cap) {
  const lines = [];
  for (const [title, items] of sections) {
    lines.push('## ' + title);
    const shown = items.slice(0, cap);
    if (shown.length === 0) lines.push('(none)');
    else lines.push(...shown);
    if (items.length > shown.length) lines.push(`- … ${items.length - shown.length} more`);
    lines.push('');
  }
  lines.push('## How to read this folder → .memory/README.md');
  return lines;
}

function lastProcessedTs(root, index) {
  let best = '';
  for (const e of index) {
    const through = Number(e.processedThrough) || 0;
    if (through <= 0) continue;
    let ts = '';
    if (through >= (Number(e.events) || 0)) ts = e.end || '';
    else {
      try {
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(sessions.sessionFile(root, e.date, e.sid), 'utf8');
        for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
          if (!line) continue;
          try {
            const ev = JSON.parse(line);
            if (ev.seq === through) { ts = ev.ts; break; }
          } catch (_) { /* torn line */ }
        }
      } catch (_) { /* missing file */ }
    }
    if (ts && ts > best) best = ts;
  }
  return best;
}

function lastCycle() {
  try {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(path.join(logsDir(), 'cycles.jsonl'), 'utf8').trim().split('\n');
    const last = JSON.parse(lines[lines.length - 1]);
    return `${last.status === 'ok' ? 'ok' : 'failed'} ${display(last.ts)}`;
  } catch (_) {
    return 'never';
  }
}

function headerLine(root, state, now) {
  const unprocessed = state.index.reduce((n, e) => n + Math.max(0, (Number(e.events) || 0) - (Number(e.processedThrough) || 0)), 0);
  const lp = lastProcessedTs(root, state.index);
  return `Generated: ${display(now)} · Last processed event: ${lp ? display(lp) : 'none'} · ` +
    `Unprocessed events: ${unprocessed} · Last cycle: ${lastCycle()}`;
}

/**
 * Render PROJECT_STATE.md text. Line 2 is the header; everything else is the body.
 */
function renderState(root, { now = new Date(), state = loadState(root) } = {}) {
  const title = '# Project state — ' + path.basename(path.resolve(root));
  const note = '> Generated by MEMO from .memory/records. Do not edit; corrections: `memo note` or `memo clear --record`.';
  const sections = buildSections(state, now);
  let cap = SECTION_MAX;
  let body = assembleBody(sections, cap);
  while (body.length + 4 > MAX_LINES && cap > 1) {
    cap--;
    body = assembleBody(sections, cap);
  }
  return [title, headerLine(root, state, now), note, '', ...body].join('\n') + '\n';
}

// Write a generated file, keeping the old header line when the body did not change.
function writeKeepingHeader(file, text) {
  let old = null;
  try { old = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { /* first write */ }
  const strip = (s) => s.split('\n').filter((_, i) => i !== 1).join('\n');
  if (old !== null && strip(old) === strip(text)) return false;
  writeFileAtomic(file, text);
  return true;
}

function statePath(root) {
  return path.join(memoryDir(root), 'PROJECT_STATE.md');
}

function writeState(root, opts = {}) {
  return writeKeepingHeader(statePath(root), renderState(root, opts));
}

module.exports = {
  renderState, writeState, display, writeKeepingHeader, statePath, loadState, buildSections,
  sessionsNewestFirst, sessionLink, label, oneLine, byPriorityAge, byTsDesc, OPEN_TASK, OPEN_ERROR
};

'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const MEMO = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'bin', 'memo.js');
const HAS_GIT = !spawnSync('git', ['--version'], { windowsHide: true }).error;

function setup(t) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-init-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, 'repo');
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  const gitConfig = path.join(base, 'gitconfig');
  fs.mkdirSync(root);
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  fs.writeFileSync(gitConfig, '[user]\n\tname = MEMO Test\n\temail = memo@test.invalid\n[commit]\n\tgpgsign = false\n');
  const env = {
    ...process.env,
    MEMO_HOME: home,
    GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: gitConfig,
    GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1'
  };
  delete env.MEMO_INTERNAL_COMMIT;
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const git = (args, extraEnv = {}) => execFileSync('git', args, {
    cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env: { ...env, ...extraEnv }
  });
  const memo = (args) => execFileSync(process.execPath, [MEMO, ...args], {
    cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env
  });
  return { root, home, git, memo };
}

function progress(root) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'progress.md'), 'utf8');
}

function entryCount(root) {
  return (progress(root).match(/^## .* · commit /gm) || []).length;
}

test('init installs an LF-only post-commit hook and records commits', { skip: !HAS_GIT && 'git not installed' }, (t) => {
  const { root, git, memo } = setup(t);
  git(['init', '-q']);
  memo(['init']);

  const hookPath = path.resolve(root, git(['rev-parse', '--git-path', 'hooks']).trim(), 'post-commit');
  const hook = fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8');
  assert.ok(hook.includes('# memo-hook'));
  assert.ok(!hook.includes('\r'), 'hook must not contain CR');

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'a.txt'), 'hello\n');
  git(['add', 'a.txt']);
  git(['commit', '-q', '-m', 'add a']);
  assert.equal(entryCount(root), 1);
  assert.match(progress(root), /add a/);

  git(['add', '-A', '--', '.memory']);
  git(['commit', '-q', '-m', 'memory only', '--', '.memory']);
  assert.equal(entryCount(root), 1, 'memory-only commit must not add an entry');

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'b.txt'), 'b\n');
  git(['add', 'b.txt']);
  git(['commit', '-q', '-m', 'internal'], { MEMO_INTERNAL_COMMIT: '1' });
  assert.equal(entryCount(root), 1, 'MEMO_INTERNAL_COMMIT=1 must skip the hook');
});

test('init normalizes CRLF when appending to an existing hook', { skip: !HAS_GIT && 'git not installed' }, (t) => {
  const { root, git, memo } = setup(t);
```

```text
'use strict';

// `memo commit` — commit only .memory/ (plan §3 #14, P3). Never touches other paths.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
const { repoRoot } = require('../git');
const config = require('../config');
const { log } = require('../log');
const { localDate } = require('../util');
const { findSecrets } = require('../redact');

const BUSY_MARKERS = ['index.lock', 'MERGE_HEAD', 'rebase-merge', 'rebase-apply', 'CHERRY_PICK_HEAD'];

function git(root, args, env) {
  return execFileSync('git', args, {
    cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
    env: env ? { ...process.env, ...env } : process.env
  }).trim();
}

function gitDir(root) {
  return path.resolve(root, git(root, ['rev-parse', '--git-dir']));
}

function identityMissing(root) {
  for (const key of ['user.name', 'user.email']) {
    try { if (!git(root, ['config', key])) return true; } catch (_) { return true; }
  }
  return false;
}

// Session ids touched by the staged .memory diff.
function describe(files) {
  const sids = new Set();
  for (const f of files) {
    const m = /^\.memory\/sessions\/\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}\/([^/]+)\.(jsonl|md)$/.exec(f);
    if (m) sids.add(m[1]);
  }
  return { sids: [...sids].sort() };
}

function countRecordLines(root) {
  // Added lines in record files of the staged diff = record changes.
  const out = git(root, ['diff', '--cached', '--numstat', '--', '.memory/records']);
  return out ? out.split('\n').reduce((n, l) => n + (Number(l.split('\t')[0]) || 0), 0) : 0;
}

function message(root, files) {
  const { sids } = describe(files);
  const m = countRecordLines(root);
  let msg = `memo: archive ${sids.length} session(s), ${m} record change(s) — ${localDate()}`;
  if (sids.length === 1) msg += ` (${sids[0].slice(0, 8)})`;
  return msg;
}

/**
 * @returns {{status: 'committed'|'no_changes'|'disabled'|'git_busy'|'no_identity', hash?, message?}}
 */
function commitMemory(root, { cfg = config.load(), message: custom = null } = {}) {
  if (cfg.autoCommit === false) return { status: 'disabled' };
  const gd = gitDir(root);
  const busy = BUSY_MARKERS.find((m) => fs.existsSync(path.join(gd, m)));
  if (busy) {
    log('commit', { root: path.basename(root), status: 'git_busy', marker: busy });
    return { status: 'git_busy', marker: busy };
  }
  if (!git(root, ['status', '--porcelain', '--', '.memory'])) return { status: 'no_changes' };
  if (identityMissing(root)) {
    log('commit', { root: path.basename(root), status: 'no_identity' });
    return { status: 'no_identity' };
  }
  git(root, ['add', '-A', '--', '.memory']);
  const files = git(root, ['diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '--', '.memory']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
  if (files.length === 0) return { status: 'no_changes' };
  // Last line of defence: redaction runs at capture, but never commit a recognisable credential.
  const added = git(root, ['diff', '--cached', '-U0', '--no-color', '--', '.memory']).split('\n')
    .filter((l) => l.startsWith('+') && !l.startsWith('+++')).join('\n');
  const found = findSecrets(added);
  if (found.length > 0) {
    git(root, ['reset', '-q', '--', '.memory']);
    log('commit', { root: path.basename(root), status: 'secret_blocked', formats: found });
    return { status: 'secret_blocked', formats: found };
  }
  const msg = custom || message(root, files);
  git(root, ['commit', '--no-verify', '--only', '-q', '-m', msg, '--', '.memory'], { MEMO_INTERNAL_COMMIT: '1' });
  const hash = git(root, ['rev-parse', '--short', 'HEAD']);
  log('commit', { root: path.basename(root), status: 'committed', hash, files: files.length });
  return { status: 'committed', hash, message: msg, files: files.length };
}

function command(argv = []) {
  const flag = argv.indexOf('--repo');
  const root = repoRoot(flag !== -1 && argv[flag + 1] ? path.resolve(argv[flag + 1]) : process.cwd());
  const res = commitMemory(root);
  if (res.status === 'committed') console.log(`committed ${res.hash}  ${res.message}`);
  else if (res.status === 'no_changes') console.log('no changes in .memory/');
  else if (res.status === 'disabled') console.log('autoCommit is false — nothing committed');
  else if (res.status === 'git_busy') console.log(`git is busy (${res.marker}) — try again later`);
  else if (res.status === 'secret_blocked') {
    console.error('NOT committed: .memory/ changes contain what looks like a credential (' + res.formats.join(', ') +
      '). Find it with `git diff -- .memory`, remove it (memo clear --session <sid>), and rotate that key.');
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
  else if (res.status === 'no_identity') {
    console.error('git user.name/user.email not set — MEMO will not set them for you');
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
  return res;
}
```

```text
const { redact, redactPath } = require('../src/redact');

const KEY_FILE = path.join(ROOT, 'groq_key.md');

const MARKER = /^<!-- codebase-summary base=([0-9a-f]{40}) model=(\S+) at=(\S+) -->$/m;

// Session transcripts, patches and personal notes are noise or private; key files never leave the machine.
const SKIP = /^(\.memory\/(sessions|records)\/|\.specstory\/|memory\/|\.vscode\/|test\/fixtures\/)|\.patch$|_key\.md$|^codebase_summary\.md$/;
const MAX_FILE = 40000;
const MAX_TEST_FILE = 4000;
const MAX_DIFF = 200000;

function git(args) {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: ROOT, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });
}

function readKey() {
  if (process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) return process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY.trim();
  const line = fs.readFileSync(KEY_FILE, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/)[1] || '';
  return line.slice(line.indexOf('=') + 1).trim();
}

const included = (p) => !SKIP.test(p) && !redactPath(p);

function fileBlock(rel) {
  let text;
  try { text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, rel), 'utf8'); } catch (_) { return ''; }
  const cap = rel.startsWith('test/') ? MAX_TEST_FILE : MAX_FILE;
  const cut = text.length > cap ? text.slice(0, cap) + '\n…[truncated ' + (text.length - cap) + ' chars]' : text;
  return '=== ' + rel + ' ===\n' + redact(cut).text + '\n';
}
```

```text
    if (typeof next === 'function') return next();
    return next;
  };
  fn.calls = calls;
  return fn;
}

  const slept = [];
  return {
    impl: { fetchImpl, apiKey: KEY, sleep: (ms) => slept.push(ms), backoff: [1, 2, 3], ...extra },
    slept
  };
}
```

```javascript
'use strict';

// The memo block in the instruction files other agents load on their own:
//   AGENTS.md                         Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot agent mode
//   .github/copilot-instructions.md   GitHub Copilot (chat and coding agent)
//   GEMINI.md                         Gemini CLI / Code Assist
// Claude Code gets the same facts pushed by the SessionStart hook; these agents run no hook,
// so the block carries a snapshot of the state inline instead of only a pointer to it.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const state = require('./state');
const { writeFileAtomic } = require('../util');

const AGENT_FILES = ['AGENTS.md', '.github/copilot-instructions.md', 'GEMINI.md'];
const BLOCK_RE = /<!-- memo:start -->[\s\S]*?<!-- memo:end -->\n?/;
const OLD_AGENTS_LINE = 'Read .memory/BRIEF.md before starting.';
const MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHARS = 3500;
const STALE_MS = 24 * 3600 * 1000;

function template() {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'templates', 'AGENTS.block.md'), 'utf8').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
}

// Derived from the data only (never the clock), so the block changes only when the memory does.
function snapshot(root, loaded = state.loadState(root)) {
  const { sections } = require('../context');
  const last = state.lastProcessedTs(root, loaded.index);
  const newest = loaded.index.reduce((best, e) => (e.end && e.end > best ? e.end : best), '');
  const pending = loaded.index.some((e) => (Number(e.events) || 0) > (Number(e.processedThrough) || 0));
  const stale = pending && (!last || Date.parse(newest) - Date.parse(last) > STALE_MS);
  const lines = ['', '### Snapshot (sessions processed up to ' + (last ? last.slice(0, 10) : 'none') + ')'];
  if (stale) lines.push('> Stale: newer sessions are captured but not processed yet — run `memo status`. Check the code before trusting old items.');
  let size = lines.join('\n').length;
  for (const [title, items] of sections(loaded, { items: 5, intents: 3, sessionChars: 200 })) {
    if (items.length === 0) continue;
    const head = title + ':';
    if (size + head.length + 2 > MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHARS) break;
    lines.push(head);
    size += head.length + 1;
    for (const item of items) {
      if (size + item.length + 1 > MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHARS) break;
      lines.push(item);
      size += item.length + 1;
    }
  }
  if (lines.length === 2 + (stale ? 1 : 0)) lines.push('(no records yet)');
  return lines.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function block(root) {
  return template().replace('{{SNAPSHOT}}', snapshot(root));
}

// File text with the block replaced, or appended when the file has none.
function withBlock(existing, text) {
  if (existing === null) return text;
  const body = existing.replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n');
  if (BLOCK_RE.test(body)) return body.replace(BLOCK_RE, () => text);
  const kept = body.split('\n').filter((l) => l !== OLD_AGENTS_LINE).join('\n').replace(/\n*$/, '');
  return (kept ? kept + '\n\n' : '') + text;
}

function read(file) {
  try { return fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { return null; }
}

function write(file, existing, content) {
  if (existing !== null && existing.replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n') === content) return 'skipped';
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  writeFileAtomic(file, content);
  return existing === null ? 'created' : 'updated';
}

// `memo init`: every agent file gets the block. Returns [[status, relPath]].
function install(root) {
  const text = block(root);
  return AGENT_FILES.map((rel) => {
    const file = path.join(root, rel);
    const existing = read(file);
    return [write(file, existing, withBlock(existing, text)), rel];
  });
}

// Each cycle / `memo report`: refresh only the files that still carry the block.
function refresh(root) {
  const text = block(root);
  const changed = [];
  for (const rel of AGENT_FILES) {
    const file = path.join(root, rel);
    const existing = read(file);
    if (existing === null || !BLOCK_RE.test(existing)) continue;
    if (write(file, existing, withBlock(existing, text)) !== 'skipped') changed.push(rel);
  }
  return changed;
}

// Same text once the generated block is taken out (line endings ignored).
function sameOutsideBlock(a, b) {
  const strip = (s) => String(s).replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n').replace(BLOCK_RE, '').trim();
  return strip(a) === strip(b);
}

module.exports = { AGENT_FILES, BLOCK_RE, snapshot, block, withBlock, install, refresh, sameOutsideBlock };
```

```text
const test = require('node:test');

const MEMO = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'bin', 'memo.js');

const skip = !HAS_GIT && 'git not installed';
const CFG = { autoCommit: true };

function setup(t, { identity = true } = {}) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-commit-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, 'my repo');
  fs.mkdirSync(root);
  const gitConfig = path.join(base, 'gitconfig');
  fs.writeFileSync(gitConfig, (identity ? '[user]\n\tname = MEMO Test\n\temail = memo@test.invalid\n' : '') + '[commit]\n\tgpgsign = false\n');
  const saved = {};
  const env = { GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: gitConfig, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1', MEMO_HOME: path.join(base, 'home'),
    GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: undefined, GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: undefined, GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: undefined, GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: undefined, EMAIL: undefined };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(env)) {
    saved[k] = process.env[k];
    if (v === undefined) delete process.env[k]; else process.env[k] = v;
  }
  t.after(() => {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(saved)) { if (v === undefined) delete process.env[k]; else process.env[k] = v; }
    fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });
  const git = (...args) => execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true }).trim();
  git('init', '-q');
  if (!identity) git('config', 'user.useConfigOnly', 'true');
  const write = (rel, text) => {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(root, rel)), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, rel), text);
  };
  return { root, git, write };
}

function seedBase({ git, write }) {
  write('src.js', '1\n');
  write('b.js', '1\n');
  write('.memory/keep.md', 'k\n');
  git('add', '.');
  git('-c', 'user.name=Seed', '-c', 'user.email=seed@test.invalid', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'base');
}
```

```text
1	# MEMO
2	
3	MEMO is a zero-dependency Node.js CLI that gives a Git repo a persistent memory for AI coding agents.
4	
5	## Where memory lives
6	- `.memory/` (tracked): project memory — progress log, decisions, errors, next steps, and later `PROJECT_STATE.md`.
7	- `~/.memo/` (per machine, never in Git): personal notes, logs, local state.
8	
9	## Before starting work
10	- Read `.memory/PROJECT_STATE.md` if it exists (`memo report` regenerates it).
11	- If it does not exist, read `.memory/progress.md`.
12	
13	## Code map
14	- `bin/memo.js` — CLI entry (`init | note | hook | report | context | commit | migrate | setup claude | capture | config | process | cycle | status | doctor | pause | resume | install | sessions | show | tasks | clear | console`).
15	- `src/` — implementation (paths, git, init, note, hook, brief, redact, config, usage, lock, log, repos).
16	- `src/cycle.js`, `src/status.js`, `src/install.js` — the 15-minute run, `memo status`/`doctor`, first-run setup.
17	- `src/delete.js`, `src/browse.js`, `src/ui/menu.js` — `memo clear`, the read-only views and `memo console`.
18	- `scripts/windows/` — `install_memo.bat`, `uninstall_memo.bat`, `register-task.ps1`, `run-hidden.vbs` (CRLF).
19	- `src/capture/`, `src/store/` — Claude Code capture and the session/record files.
20	- `src/llm/`, `src/extract/` — provider clients and `memo process` extraction (see `docs/PHASE2_API_EXTRACTION.md`).
21	- `src/report/`, `src/context.js` — `PROJECT_STATE.md`, `TASKS.md`, and the SessionStart context.
22	- `src/gitops/memory-commit.js`, `src/migrate.js` — `.memory/`-only commits and legacy-note import.
```

```text
/**
 * Capture one session of one registered repo.
 * @returns {{status: string, newEvents: number}}
 */
function captureSession({ repo, sid, transcriptPath, event = 'sweep', source, lockWaitMs = 1500 }) {
  const root = repo.root;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const sid8 = String(sid).slice(0, 8);
  if (!sessions.validSid(sid)) {
    log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, status: 'invalid_sid' });
    return { status: 'invalid_sid', newEvents: 0 };
  }
  const lock = acquire(path.join(stateDir(repo.id), 'capture.lock'), { staleMs: 60000, waitMs: lockWaitMs });
  if (!lock) {
    log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'busy' });
    return { status: 'busy', newEvents: 0 };
  }
  if (lock.recovered) log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'stale_lock_recovered' });
  try {
    const cPath = cursorsPath(repo.id);
    const cursors = readJson(cPath, {});
    let cur = cursors[sid];
    const tPath = transcriptPath || (cur && cur.transcriptPath);
    const index = sessions.loadIndex(root);
    const before = JSON.stringify(index);
    let entry = index.find((e) => e.sid === sid);

    // Deleted by `memo clear` — never import it again from the Claude transcript (P5).
    if (entry && entry.deletedAt) {
      const cursors = readJson(cursorsPath(repo.id), {});
      if (cursors[sid]) {
        delete cursors[sid];
        writeJsonAtomic(cursorsPath(repo.id), cursors);
      }
      log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'tombstoned' });
      return { status: 'tombstoned', newEvents: 0 };
    }

    const setStatus = () => {
      if (!entry) return;
      if (event === 'SessionEnd') entry.status = 'ended';
      else if (event === 'SessionStart' || (entry.status === 'transcript_missing' && event !== 'sweep')) entry.status = 'active';
    };
    const saveIndexIfChanged = () => {
      if (JSON.stringify(index) !== before) sessions.saveIndex(root, index);
    };

    let stat = null;
    if (tPath) {
      try { stat = fs.statSync(tPath); } catch (_) { stat = null; }
    }
    if (!stat) {
      // SessionStart may fire before the transcript file exists: remember the path, no gap.
      if (tPath && (!cur || cur.transcriptPath !== tPath)) {
        cursors[sid] = { ...(cur || { offset: 0, lineNo: 0, tools: {} }), transcriptPath: tPath };
        writeJsonAtomic(cPath, cursors);
      }
      let status = tPath ? 'transcript_missing' : 'no_transcript';
      if (event === 'SessionStart' && !entry) status = 'waiting_for_transcript';
      else if (entry && event !== 'SessionEnd') entry.status = 'transcript_missing';
      setStatus();
      saveIndexIfChanged();
      log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status, ms: Date.now() - t0 });
      return { status, newEvents: 0 };
    }

    if (!cur) cur = { transcriptPath: tPath, offset: 0, lineNo: 0, tools: {} };
    cur.transcriptPath = tPath;
    cur.tools = cur.tools || {};
    let status = 'ok';
    if (stat.size < cur.offset) {
      log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'transcript_rewritten', oldOffset: cur.offset, size: stat.size });
      cur.offset = 0;
      cur.lineNo = 0;
      status = 'transcript_rewritten';
    }

    const envelopes = [];
    let badLines = 0;
    let consumed = 0;
    if (stat.size > cur.offset) {
      const buf = readRange(tPath, cur.offset, stat.size);
      const lastNl = buf.lastIndexOf(0x0a);
      if (lastNl >= 0) {
        consumed = lastNl + 1;
        const text = buf.subarray(0, consumed).toString('utf8');
        const ctx = { sid, root, cwd: root, home: os.homedir(), tools: cur.tools, denyPaths: loadDenyPaths() };
        for (const rawLine of text.slice(0, -1).split('\n')) {
          cur.lineNo++;
          const raw = rawLine.replace(/\r$/, '');
          if (!raw.trim()) continue;
          let obj;
          try { obj = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) {
            badLines++;
            log('capture', { event, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status: 'bad_line', line: cur.lineNo });
            continue;
          }
          ctx.lineNo = cur.lineNo;
          ctx.raw = raw;
          for (const env of normalize(obj, ctx)) envelopes.push(env);
        }
      }
      // bytes after the last "\n" are an incomplete line: left for the next run
    }

    let added = [];
    if (envelopes.length > 0) {
      const date = entry ? entry.date : localDate(envelopes[0].ts);
      const file = sessions.sessionFile(root, date, sid);
      const existing = sessions.readExisting(file);
      let seq = existing.lastSeq;
      for (const env of envelopes) {
        if (existing.ids.has(env.id)) continue;
        existing.ids.add(env.id);
        seq++;
        const { v, id, sid: s, ts, agent, type, ...rest } = env;
        added.push({ v, id, sid: s, seq, ts, agent, type, ...rest });
      }
      sessions.appendEvents(file, added);
      if (added.length > 0) {
        if (!entry) {
          entry = { sid, agent: 'claude-code', date, start: added[0].ts, end: added[0].ts, events: 0, processedThrough: 0, summary: '', status: 'active' };
          index.push(entry);
        }
        entry.events = seq;
        entry.end = added[added.length - 1].ts;
      }
    }

    cur.offset += consumed;
    cur.fileSize = stat.size;
    if (added.length > 0) cur.lastEventId = added[added.length - 1].id;
    cur.tools = trimTools(cur.tools);
    cursors[sid] = cur;
    writeJsonAtomic(cPath, cursors);

    setStatus();
    saveIndexIfChanged();
    log('capture', { event, source, repo: repo.id, sid: sid8, status, newEvents: added.length, badLines, ms: Date.now() - t0 });
    return { status, newEvents: added.length };
  } finally {
    lock.release();
  }
}

// Catch up every known session of one repo. Never throws.
function sweepRepo(repo) {
  const results = [];
  let cursors = {};
  try { cursors = readJson(cursorsPath(repo.id), {}); } catch (err) {
    log('capture', { event: 'sweep', repo: repo.id, status: 'bad_cursors', error: err.message });
    return results;
  }
  for (const sid of Object.keys(cursors)) {
    try {
      results.push({ repo: repo.id, sid, ...captureSession({ repo, sid, event: 'sweep', lockWaitMs: 5000 }) });
    } catch (err) {
      log('capture', { event: 'sweep', repo: repo.id, sid: sid.slice(0, 8), status: 'error', error: err.message });
      results.push({ repo: repo.id, sid, status: 'error', newEvents: 0 });
    }
  }
  return results;
}

function sweep() {
  const results = [];
  for (const repo of repos.load()) {
    if (!repo.enabled) continue;
    for (const r of sweepRepo(repo)) results.push(r);
  }
  return results;
}

async function hookEntry() {
  const raw = await readStdin();
  let data;
  try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (_) {
    log('capture', { event: 'unknown', status: 'bad_stdin', bytes: raw.length });
    return;
  }
  const event = String(data.hook_event_name || 'unknown');
  const cwd = data.cwd || process.cwd();
  let root;
  try { root = repoRoot(cwd); } catch (_) {
    log('capture', { event, status: 'skip_not_git' });
    return;
  }
  const repo = repos.find(root);
  if (!repo || repo.enabled === false) {
    log('capture', { event, status: 'skip_unregistered' });
    return;
  }
  captureSession({
    repo,
    sid: data.session_id,
    transcriptPath: data.transcript_path,
    event,
    source: data.source || data.reason,
    lockWaitMs: event === 'SessionEnd' ? 800 : 1500
  });
  if (event === 'SessionStart') printContext(root);
}

// SessionStart stdout is added to Claude's context. fs.writeSync: the caller exits right after.
function printContext(root) {
  try {
    const text = require('../context').buildContext(root);
    if (text) fs.writeSync(1, text);
  } catch (err) {
    log('capture', { event: 'SessionStart', status: 'context_error', error: err.message });
  }
}

// CLI: always resolves, never throws.
async function command(argv = []) {
  try {
    if (argv.includes('--sweep')) {
      const results = sweep();
      const total = results.reduce((n, r) => n + (r.newEvents || 0), 0);
      if (process.stdout.isTTY || argv.includes('--verbose')) {
        console.log(`swept ${results.length} session(s), ${total} new event(s)`);
      }
      return;
    }
    await hookEntry();
  } catch (err) {
    log('capture', { status: 'error', error: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err) });
  }
}

module.exports = { command, captureSession, sweep, sweepRepo, cursorsPath, readStdin };
```
