'use strict';

// Claude Code transcript line → MEMO event envelopes (§6.1).
// The transcript format is not a documented contract: be tolerant, drop what is unknown.

const { redact, redactPath, DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS } = require('../redact');
const { sha1, isoLocal } = require('../util');

const LIMITS = { user_prompt: 4000, assistant_text: 3000, tool_call: 300, system: 300 };
const RESULT_HEAD = 500;
const RESULT_TAIL = 300;
const FILE_TOOLS = new Set(['Read', 'Write', 'Edit', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit', 'NotebookRead']);
const CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS = new Set(['Read', 'NotebookRead']); // results dropped entirely
const WRITE_TOOLS = new Set(['Write', 'Edit', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit']); // results reduced to ok/error

function cut(text, max) {
  if (text.length <= max) return { text, truncated: false };
  return { text: text.slice(0, max), truncated: true };
}

function cutResult(text) {
  if (text.length <= RESULT_HEAD + RESULT_TAIL) return { text, truncated: false };
  return { text: `${text.slice(0, RESULT_HEAD)}\n…\n${text.slice(-RESULT_TAIL)}`, truncated: true };
}

function isWinAbs(p) { return /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(p); }
function isAbs(p) { return p.startsWith('/') || p.startsWith('\\\\') || isWinAbs(p); }
function slashes(p) { return String(p).replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, ''); }
function cmpKey(p) { return isWinAbs(p) ? slashes(p).toLowerCase() : slashes(p); }

// Repo-relative forward-slash path, "<outside-repo>" for anything outside, null if unusable.
function relPath(p, ctx) {
  if (typeof p !== 'string' || !p.trim()) return null;
  let abs = p.trim();
  if (!isAbs(abs)) {
    if (!ctx.cwd) return slashes(abs).split('/').includes('..') ? '<outside-repo>' : slashes(abs);
    abs = `${slashes(ctx.cwd)}/${abs}`;
  }
  const parts = [];
  for (const seg of slashes(abs).split('/')) {
    if (seg === '..') parts.pop();
    else if (seg !== '.') parts.push(seg);
  }
  const full = parts.join('/');
  const root = cmpKey(ctx.root);
  const key = cmpKey(full);
  if (key === root) return '.';
  if (!key.startsWith(root + '/')) return '<outside-repo>';
  return full.slice(slashes(ctx.root).length + 1);
}

// Checked on the raw path too, so a denied file outside the repo is also dropped.
function denied(raw, ctx) {
  if (typeof raw !== 'string' || !raw) return false;
  return redactPath(slashes(raw).replace(/^[A-Za-z]:/, ''), ctx.denyPaths || DEFAULT_DENY_PATHS);
}

// Hide absolute machine paths inside free text.
function scrubPaths(text, ctx) {
  let out = text;
  const swap = (base, label) => {
    if (!base) return;
    const variants = new Set([base, base.replace(/\//g, '\\'), base.replace(/\\/g, '/')]);
    for (const v of variants) {
      if (v.length < 4) continue;
      const re = new RegExp(v.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), isWinAbs(v) ? 'gi' : 'g');
      out = out.replace(re, label);
    }
  };
  swap(ctx.root, '<repo>');
  swap(ctx.home, '~');
  return out;
}

function stripReminders(text) {
  return text.replace(/<system-reminder>[\s\S]*?<\/system-reminder>/g, '').trim();
}

function contentText(content) {
  if (typeof content === 'string') return content;
  if (!Array.isArray(content)) return '';
  return content.filter((c) => c && c.type === 'text' && typeof c.text === 'string').map((c) => c.text).join('\n');
}

function countLines(s) {
  return typeof s === 'string' && s ? s.split('\n').length : 0;
}

// Short description of a tool call + the paths it touches.
function describeToolUse(name, input, ctx) {
  const inp = input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {};
  const paths = [];
  let text;
  if (FILE_TOOLS.has(name)) {
    const p = inp.file_path || inp.notebook_path || inp.path;
    const rel = relPath(p, ctx);
    if (typeof p === 'string') paths.push(p);
    text = rel || '(no path)';
    if (name === 'Write') text += ` (${countLines(inp.content)} lines)`;
    if (name === 'Edit') text += ` (-${countLines(inp.old_string)} +${countLines(inp.new_string)} lines)`;
    if (name === 'MultiEdit' && Array.isArray(inp.edits)) text += ` (${inp.edits.length} edits)`;
  } else if (name === 'Bash' || name === 'PowerShell') {
    text = String(inp.command || '');
    for (const tok of text.split(/[\s"'`;|&<>()=]+/)) {
      if (tok && /[./\\]/.test(tok)) paths.push(tok);
    }
  } else if (name === 'Glob' || name === 'Grep') {
    const rel = inp.path ? relPath(inp.path, ctx) : null;
    if (typeof inp.path === 'string') paths.push(inp.path);
    text = `${inp.pattern || ''}${rel ? ` in ${rel}` : ''}`;
  } else if (name === 'WebFetch') {
    text = String(inp.url || '');
  } else if (name === 'WebSearch') {
    text = String(inp.query || '');
  } else if (name === 'Task' || name === 'Agent') {
    text = String(inp.description || inp.subagent_type || '');
  } else if (name === 'TodoWrite' && Array.isArray(inp.todos)) {
    text = inp.todos.map((t) => `[${t.status || '?'}] ${t.content || ''}`).join('; ');
  } else {
    try { text = JSON.stringify(inp); } catch (_) { text = ''; }
  }
  return { text, paths };
}

function makeId(sid, line, raw, blockIndex) {
  return `e-${sha1(`${sid}${line.uuid || raw}${blockIndex}`).slice(0, 8)}`;
}

function finish(env, limit, ctx) {
  const scrubbed = scrubPaths(env.text, ctx);
  const red = redact(scrubbed).text;
  const c = env.type === 'tool_result' ? cutResult(red) : cut(red, limit);
  env.text = redact(c.text).text;
  if (c.truncated) env.truncated = true;
  return env;
}

 * @param {object} line parsed transcript line

 *                      ctx.tools is mutated (tool_use ids remembered for their later results).
 * @returns {object[]} envelopes without seq
 */
function normalize(line, ctx) {
  if (!line || typeof line !== 'object') return [];
  if (line.isSidechain === true) return []; // subagent transcripts: not captured in MVP
  const out = [];
  const tools = ctx.tools || (ctx.tools = {});
  const lctx = { ...ctx, cwd: line.cwd || ctx.cwd };
  const base = (blockIndex, type) => {
    const env = { v: 1, id: makeId(ctx.sid, line, ctx.raw || '', blockIndex), sid: ctx.sid, ts: isoLocal(line.timestamp), agent: 'claude-code', type };
    return env;
  };
  const src = () => ({ line: ctx.lineNo, ...(line.uuid ? { uuid: line.uuid } : {}) });

  if (line.type === 'system') {
    if (line.subtype === 'compact_boundary') {
      out.push({ ...base(0, 'system'), text: 'context compacted', src: src() });
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (line.type !== 'user' && line.type !== 'assistant') return out;
  const msg = line.message && typeof line.message === 'object' ? line.message : {};
  const content = msg.content;

  if (line.type === 'user') {
    if (line.isMeta === true) return out;
    if (line.isCompactSummary === true) return out; // model-written summary; compact_boundary marks the event
    const items = typeof content === 'string' ? [{ type: 'text', text: content }] : Array.isArray(content) ? content : [];
    const texts = [];
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
      if (item.type === 'text' && typeof item.text === 'string') {
        texts.push(item.text);
      } else if (item.type === 'tool_result') {
        const known = tools[item.tool_use_id];
        const name = known ? known[0] : null;
        if (known && known[1]) return; // denied path
        if (name && CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS.has(name)) return; // never store file contents
        const env = { ...base(i, 'tool_result') };
        if (name) env.tool = name;
        if (item.is_error === true) env.ok = false;
        else if (item.is_error === false) env.ok = true;
        let text = contentText(item.content);
        if (name && WRITE_TOOLS.has(name)) text = env.ok === false ? text : 'ok';
        env.text = text;
        env.src = src();
        out.push(finish(env, 0, lctx));
      }
    });
    let text = stripReminders(texts.join('\n'));
    if (!text) return out;
    if (/<local-command-stdout>|<local-command-stderr>/.test(text)) return out;
    const cmd = text.match(/<command-name>([\s\S]*?)<\/command-name>/);
    if (cmd) {
      const args = (text.match(/<command-args>([\s\S]*?)<\/command-args>/) || [])[1] || '';
      out.unshift(finish({ ...base('cmd', 'system'), text: `command ${cmd[1].trim()} ${args.trim()}`.trim(), src: src() }, LIMITS.system, lctx));
      return out;
    }
    if (/^\[Request interrupted by user/.test(text)) {
      out.unshift({ ...base('int', 'system'), text: 'interrupted by user', src: src() });
      return out;
    }
    out.unshift(finish({ ...base('text', 'user_prompt'), text, src: src() }, LIMITS.user_prompt, lctx));
    return out;
  }

  // assistant
  const items = typeof content === 'string' ? [{ type: 'text', text: content }] : Array.isArray(content) ? content : [];
  items.forEach((item, i) => {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
    const blockIndex = typeof line.apiBlockIndex === 'number' ? `${line.apiBlockIndex}.${i}` : i;
    if (item.type === 'text' && typeof item.text === 'string' && item.text.trim()) {
      out.push(finish({ ...base(blockIndex, 'assistant_text'), text: item.text.trim(), src: src() }, LIMITS.assistant_text, lctx));
    } else if (item.type === 'tool_use') {
      const name = String(item.name || 'unknown');
      const { text, paths } = describeToolUse(name, item.input, lctx);
      const isDenied = paths.some((p) => denied(p, lctx));
      if (item.id) tools[item.id] = isDenied ? [name, 1] : [name];
      if (isDenied) return;
      out.push(finish({ ...base(blockIndex, 'tool_call'), tool: name, text, src: src() }, LIMITS.tool_call, lctx));
    }
    // thinking, redacted_thinking, image, anything else: dropped
  });
  return out;
}

module.exports = { normalize, relPath, LIMITS };
'use strict';

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { sessionsDir } = require('../paths');
const { readJson, writeJsonAtomic } = require('../util');

const SID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/;

function validSid(sid) {
  return typeof sid === 'string' && SID_RE.test(sid);
}

function indexPath(root) {
  return path.join(sessionsDir(root), 'index.json');
}

function loadIndex(root) {
  const list = readJson(indexPath(root), []);
  return Array.isArray(list) ? list : [];
}

function saveIndex(root, list) {
  writeJsonAtomic(indexPath(root), list);
}

// .memory/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/<sid>.jsonl
function sessionFile(root, date, sid) {
  if (!validSid(sid)) throw new Error(`invalid session id: ${sid}`);
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) throw new Error(`invalid date: ${date}`);
  const [y, m, d] = date.split('-');
  return path.join(sessionsDir(root), y, m, d, `${sid}.jsonl`);
}

// Ids and last seq already in a session file (for dedup + continuous seq).
function readExisting(file) {
  const ids = new Set();
  let lastSeq = 0;
  let raw;
  try { raw = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ENOENT') return { ids, lastSeq };
    throw err;
  }
  for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
    if (!line) continue;
    try {
      const e = JSON.parse(line);
      if (e.id) ids.add(e.id);
      if (typeof e.seq === 'number' && e.seq > lastSeq) lastSeq = e.seq;
    } catch (_) { /* a torn line is ignored; dedup still works for the rest */ }

'use strict';

// GitHub Copilot agent sessions (Copilot CLI and the VS Code agent host) → MEMO event envelopes.
//
//   <COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot>/session-state/<sid>/workspace.yaml   cwd:, git_root:
//   <COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot>/session-state/<sid>/events.jsonl     {type, data, id, timestamp}
//
// Copilot runs no MEMO hook, so the sweep finds these sessions by their git root.
// Like the Claude transcript, the format is not a documented contract: unknown types are dropped.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { relPath, denied, finish, cmpKey, LIMITS } = require('./claude');
const { sha1, isoLocal } = require('../util');

const CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS = new Set(['view', 'read_file', 'show_file']);
const WRITE_TOOLS = new Set(['edit', 'create', 'write_file', 'str_replace', 'apply_patch']);

function copilotHome() {
  return process.env.COPILOT_HOME || path.join(os.homedir(), '.copilot');
}

function yamlValue(text, key) {
  const m = new RegExp('^' + key + ':\\s*(.+?)\\s*$', 'm').exec(text);
  return m ? m[1].replace(/^(['"])(.*)\1$/, '$2') : null;
}

// Sessions whose git root (or cwd) is this repo: [{sid, transcriptPath}].
function discover(root) {
  const dir = path.join(copilotHome(), 'session-state');
  let names;
  try { names = fs.readdirSync(dir); } catch (_) { return []; }
  const want = cmpKey(root);
  const out = [];
  for (const sid of names) {
    let yaml;
    try { yaml = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, sid, 'workspace.yaml'), 'utf8'); } catch (_) { continue; }
    const where = yamlValue(yaml, 'git_root') || yamlValue(yaml, 'cwd');
    if (!where || cmpKey(where) !== want) continue;
    const transcriptPath = path.join(dir, sid, 'events.jsonl');
    if (fs.existsSync(transcriptPath)) out.push({ sid, transcriptPath });
  }
  return out;
}

function describeTool(name, args, ctx) {
  const a = args && typeof args === 'object' ? args : {};
  const p = a.path || a.filePath || a.file_path;
  const paths = typeof p === 'string' ? [p] : [];
  let text;
  if (typeof p === 'string') text = relPath(p, ctx) || '(no path)';
  else if (typeof a.command === 'string') {
    text = a.command;
    for (const tok of text.split(/[\s"'`;|&<>()=]+/)) if (tok && /[./\\]/.test(tok)) paths.push(tok);
  } else if (typeof a.pattern === 'string') text = a.pattern;
  else if (typeof a.query === 'string') text = a.query;
  else if (typeof a.url === 'string') text = a.url;
  else {
    try { text = JSON.stringify(a); } catch (_) { text = ''; }
  }
  return { text, paths };
}

/**
 * @param {object} line one events.jsonl object
 * @param {object} ctx  same as the Claude normalizer; ctx.tools maps toolCallId → [name, denied?]
 */
function normalize(line, ctx) {
  if (!line || typeof line !== 'object' || !line.data || typeof line.data !== 'object') return [];
  const d = line.data;
  const tools = ctx.tools || (ctx.tools = {});
  const env = (type, extra) => ({
    v: 1, id: 'e-' + sha1(ctx.sid + (line.id || ctx.raw || '')).slice(0, 8), sid: ctx.sid,
    ts: isoLocal(line.timestamp), agent: 'copilot', type, ...extra, src: { line: ctx.lineNo }
  });

  if (line.type === 'user.message') {
    const text = typeof d.content === 'string' ? d.content.trim() : '';
    return text ? [finish(env('user_prompt', { text }), LIMITS.user_prompt, ctx)] : [];
  }
  if (line.type === 'assistant.message') {
    const text = typeof d.content === 'string' ? d.content.trim() : '';
    return text ? [finish(env('assistant_text', { text }), LIMITS.assistant_text, ctx)] : [];
  }
  if (line.type === 'tool.execution_start') {
    const name = String(d.toolName || 'unknown');
    const { text, paths } = describeTool(name, d.arguments, ctx);
    const isDenied = paths.some((p) => denied(p, ctx));
    if (d.toolCallId) tools[d.toolCallId] = isDenied ? [name, 1] : [name];
    return isDenied ? [] : [finish(env('tool_call', { tool: name, text }), LIMITS.tool_call, ctx)];
  }
  if (line.type === 'tool.execution_complete') {
    const known = tools[d.toolCallId];
    if (known && known[1]) return [];
    const name = known ? known[0] : null;
    if (name && CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS.has(name)) return [];
    const ok = d.success === true ? true : d.success === false ? false : undefined;
    let text = d.result && typeof d.result.content === 'string' ? d.result.content
      : d.error && typeof d.error.message === 'string' ? d.error.message : '';
    if (name && WRITE_TOOLS.has(name) && ok !== false) text = 'ok';
    const out = env('tool_result', { text });
    if (name) out.tool = name;
    if (ok !== undefined) out.ok = ok;
    return [finish(out, 0, ctx)];
  }
  if (line.type === 'session.compaction_complete') return [env('system', { text: 'context compacted' })];
  return [];
}

module.exports = { normalize, discover, copilotHome };

const test = require('node:test');

const HAS_GIT = !spawnSync('git', ['--version'], { windowsHide: true }).error;

function setup(t, { repoName = 'repo', init = true } = {}) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-cap-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, repoName);
  const home = path.join(base, 'home');
  const transcripts = path.join(base, 'transcripts');
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  fs.mkdirSync(transcripts);
  const env = { ...process.env, MEMO_HOME: home, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1' };
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root, windowsHide: true, env });
  const memo = (args, input) => spawnSync(process.execPath, [MEMO, ...args], {
    cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env, input
  });
  if (init) assert.equal(memo(['init']).status, 0);
  return { base, root, home, transcripts, memo, env };
}

function fixtureLines(name) {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(FIX, `${name}.jsonl`), 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

function hook(ctx, { sid, tPath, event = 'Stop', cwd, extra = {} }) {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ session_id: sid, transcript_path: tPath, cwd: cwd || ctx.root, hook_event_name: event, ...extra });
  const r = ctx.memo(['capture'], payload);
  assert.equal(r.status, 0, r.stderr);
  assert.equal(r.stderr, '');
  return r;
}

function sessionEvents(root) {
  const dir = path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions');
  const out = [];
  const walk = (d) => {
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const p = path.join(d, f.name);
      if (f.isDirectory()) walk(p);
      else if (f.name.endsWith('.jsonl')) out.push({ file: p, events: fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l)) });
    }
  };
  if (fs.existsSync(dir)) walk(dir);
  return out;
}

function index(root) {
  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json'), 'utf8'));

'use strict';

// Copilot agent sessions are found by git root on the sweep and stored like Claude Code ones.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const MEMO = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'bin', 'memo.js');
const SKIP = spawnSync('git', ['--version'], { windowsHide: true }).error && 'git not installed';
const SID = '1599537d-fb95-4a21-907c-b8ed56ad7737';

function ev(type, data, i) {
  return JSON.stringify({ type, data, id: 'id-' + i, timestamp: '2026-10-26T00:3' + i + ':00.000Z', parentId: null });
}

function setup(t) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-copilot-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, 'repo');
  const other = path.join(base, 'other');
  const copilotHome = path.join(base, 'copilot');
  for (const d of [root, other, path.join(base, 'home')]) fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const env = { ...process.env, MEMO_HOME: path.join(base, 'home'), COPILOT_HOME: copilotHome, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1' };
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root, windowsHide: true, env });
  const memo = (args) => spawnSync(process.execPath, [MEMO, ...args], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env });
  assert.equal(memo(['init']).status, 0);
  const session = (sid, gitRoot, lines) => {
    const dir = path.join(copilotHome, 'session-state', sid);
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'workspace.yaml'), 'id: ' + sid + '\ncwd: ' + gitRoot.toLowerCase() + '\ngit_root: ' + gitRoot + '\n');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'events.jsonl'), lines.join('\n') + '\n');
    return path.join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
  };
  return { root, other, memo, session };
}

function stored(root) {
  const idx = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', 'index.json'), 'utf8'));
  const entry = idx.find((e) => e.sid === SID);
  if (!entry) return { idx, entry, events: [] };
  const [y, m, d] = entry.date.split('-');
  const file = path.join(root, '.memory', 'sessions', y, m, d, SID + '.jsonl');
  return { idx, entry, events: fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').trim().split('\n').map((l) => JSON.parse(l)) };
}

test('sweep imports this repo\'s Copilot sessions, incrementally, and skips other repos', { skip: SKIP }, (t) => {
  const ctx = setup(t);
  const file = ctx.session(SID, ctx.root, [
    ev('session.start', { sessionId: SID, context: { cwd: ctx.root } }, 0),
    ev('user.message', { content: 'purani chat mein kya baat hui', transformedContent: '<current_datetime>x</current_datetime>' }, 1),
    ev('tool.execution_start', { toolCallId: 'c1', toolName: 'view', arguments: { path: path.join(ctx.root, 'src', 'a.js') } }, 2),
    ev('tool.execution_complete', { toolCallId: 'c1', success: true, result: { content: 'FILE CONTENTS' } }, 3),
    ev('tool.execution_start', { toolCallId: 'c2', toolName: 'powershell', arguments: { command: 'npm test' } }, 4),
    ev('tool.execution_complete', { toolCallId: 'c2', success: false, result: { content: '1 failing' } }, 5),
    ev('assistant.message', { content: 'Tests fail in redact.', encryptedContent: 'SECRET-BLOB', toolRequests: [] }, 6)
  ]);
  ctx.session('0b21cd05-a0d3-4546-8f85-461c35a93cb3', ctx.other, [ev('user.message', { content: 'elsewhere' }, 1)]);

  assert.equal(ctx.memo(['capture', '--sweep']).status, 0);
  const first = stored(ctx.root);
  assert.equal(first.idx.length, 1, 'only this repo');
  assert.equal(first.entry.agent, 'copilot');
  assert.deepEqual(first.events.map((e) => [e.type, e.tool || null, e.text, e.ok]), [
    ['user_prompt', null, 'purani chat mein kya baat hui', undefined],
    ['tool_call', 'view', 'src/a.js', undefined],
    ['tool_call', 'powershell', 'npm test', undefined],
    ['tool_result', 'powershell', '1 failing', false],
    ['assistant_text', null, 'Tests fail in redact.', undefined]
  ]);
  assert.ok(first.events.every((e) => e.agent === 'copilot'));
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(first.events), /FILE CONTENTS|SECRET-BLOB|current_datetime/);

  fs.appendFileSync(file, ev('user.message', { content: 'aur kuch?' }, 7) + '\n');
  assert.equal(ctx.memo(['capture', '--sweep']).status, 0);
  assert.equal(ctx.memo(['capture', '--sweep']).status, 0);
  const second = stored(ctx.root);
  assert.equal(second.events.length, 6, 'only the new line is added, nothing twice');
  assert.equal(second.events[5].text, 'aur kuch?');
  assert.equal(second.entry.events, 6);
});

Ab Copilot ki baatein bhi wahin save hoti hain jahan Claude Code ki hoti hain. Claude chat (claude.ai / Claude Desktop) ki baatein laptop pe hoti hi nahi, isliye unhe save nahi kar sakte.

**Copilot**
- Copilot (CLI aur VS Code agent dono) apni chats `~/.copilot/session-state/<id>/events.jsonl` mein rakhta hai. Har session ke `workspace.yaml` se pata chalta hai ki woh kis repo ka hai.
- Naya `src/capture/copilot.js` har 15-min cycle mein is repo ki Copilot sessions dhoondhta hai. Unhe `.memory/sessions/` mein usi format mein save karta hai jaisa Claude Code ka, aur har baar sirf naye events jodta hai.
- Copilot jo files kholta hai (`view`) unka content save nahi hota, na hi uska encrypted reasoning.
- Is machine pe import chala diya: 6 Copilot sessions ab `.memory/sessions/` mein hain.
- Agle background cycle mein inki summaries banengi aur snapshot mein aa jayengi. Uske baad Claude, Copilot aur Gemini sab inhe padh payenge.

**Ek security bug bhi mila aur fix kiya**
- Path chhupane wala code teen roop miss kar raha tha: JSON-escaped (`C:\\Users\\…`), Git Bash (`/c/Users/…`) aur file URI (`c%3A/Users/…`). Is wajah se poora machine path session files mein chala jaata tha. Yeh Claude Code capture mein bhi pehle se tha.
- Fix ke baad Copilot sessions dobara import kiye; ab un files mein koi machine path nahi hai.
- Purani Claude session files (jaise is session ki `13c60797…`) mein jo paths pehle likhe ja chuke hain, woh waise hi hain. Fix sirf nayi lines pe lagta hai.

**Claude chat**
- Claude Desktop ke folders mein is repo ki koi chat nahi mili. Wahan sirf cache aur scheduled tasks hain, chats Anthropic ke server pe hain.
- Ek raasta hai: claude.ai se data export (Settings → Privacy → Export data), fir ek `memo import` command banana. Abhi yeh nahi banaya. Chahiye to bata dena.

`npm test`: 177/177 pass. Docs update kar diye (`SUPPORTED_AGENTS.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `AGENTS.md`). Commit abhi nahi kiya.

<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```javascript
'use strict';

// Gemini in Google Antigravity → MEMO event envelopes.
//
//   <ANTIGRAVITY_HOME or ~/.gemini/antigravity>/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl
//   one step per line: {step_index, source, type, created_at, content?, tool_calls?: [{name, args}]}
//     USER_INPUT        the prompt, inside <USER_REQUEST>…</USER_REQUEST>
//     PLANNER_RESPONSE  the model's text (thinking is dropped) and its tool calls
//     GENERIC           one tool result, in the order of the calls before it
//
// The transcript names no workspace: a conversation belongs to the repo that holds the first
// absolute path its tool calls use. The format is not a documented contract: unknown steps are dropped.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { relPath, denied, finish, cmpKey, LIMITS } = require('./claude');
const { sha1, isoLocal } = require('../util');

const CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS = new Set(['view_file', 'read_file', 'view_file_outline', 'view_code_item']);
const WRITE_TOOLS = new Set(['write_to_file', 'replace_file_content', 'multi_replace_file_content']);
const PENDING = '~pending';

function home() {
  return process.env.ANTIGRAVITY_HOME || path.join(os.homedir(), '.gemini', 'antigravity');
}

// Arg values are JSON-encoded strings ("\"c:\\\\Users\\\\…\""); plain ones pass through.
function argValue(v) {
  if (typeof v !== 'string') return v;
  if (/^".*"$/s.test(v)) {
    try { return JSON.parse(v); } catch (_) { return v; }
  }
  return v;
}

function isAbsPath(v) {
  return typeof v === 'string' && (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(v) || /^\/[^/]/.test(v));
}

function firstPath(transcript) {
  let raw;
  try { raw = fs.readFileSync(transcript, 'utf8'); } catch (_) { return null; }
  for (const line of raw.split('\n')) {
    if (!line.includes('tool_calls')) continue;
    let step;
    try { step = JSON.parse(line); } catch (_) { continue; }
    for (const call of Array.isArray(step.tool_calls) ? step.tool_calls : []) {
      for (const v of Object.values(call && call.args ? call.args : {})) {
        const p = argValue(v);
        if (isAbsPath(p)) return p;
      }
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// Conversations whose first tool path is inside this repo: [{sid, transcriptPath}].
function discover(root) {
  const dir = path.join(home(), 'brain');
  let names;
  try { names = fs.readdirSync(dir); } catch (_) { return []; }
  const want = cmpKey(root);
  const out = [];
  for (const sid of names) {
    const transcriptPath = path.join(dir, sid, '.system_generated', 'logs', 'transcript.jsonl');
    const p = firstPath(transcriptPath);
    if (!p) continue;
    const key = cmpKey(p);
    if (key === want || key.startsWith(want + '/')) out.push({ sid, transcriptPath });
  }
  return out;
}

function userText(content) {
  const text = String(content || '');
  const req = /<USER_REQUEST>([\s\S]*?)<\/USER_REQUEST>/.exec(text);
  if (req) return req[1].trim();
  return text.replace(/<(ADDITIONAL_METADATA|USER_SETTINGS_CHANGE)>[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/g, '').trim();
}

function describeTool(args, ctx) {
  const a = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(args && typeof args === 'object' ? args : {})) a[k] = argValue(v);
  const paths = Object.values(a).filter(isAbsPath);
  let text;
  if (typeof a.CommandLine === 'string') text = a.CommandLine;
  else if (paths.length) text = relPath(paths[0], ctx) || '(no path)';
  else if (typeof a.Query === 'string') text = a.Query;
  else {
    try { text = JSON.stringify(a); } catch (_) { text = ''; }
  }
  return { text, paths };
}

/**
 * @param {object} line one transcript.jsonl step
 * @param {object} ctx  same as the Claude normalizer; ctx.tools['~pending'] queues call names for their results
 */
function normalize(line, ctx) {
  if (!line || typeof line !== 'object' || typeof line.type !== 'string') return [];
  const tools = ctx.tools || (ctx.tools = {});
  const pending = Array.isArray(tools[PENDING]) ? tools[PENDING] : (tools[PENDING] = []);
  const step = line.step_index !== undefined ? line.step_index : ctx.lineNo;
  const env = (part, type, extra) => ({
    v: 1, id: 'e-' + sha1(ctx.sid + ':' + step + ':' + part).slice(0, 8), sid: ctx.sid,
    ts: isoLocal(line.created_at), agent: 'gemini', type, ...extra, src: { line: ctx.lineNo }
  });

  if (line.type === 'USER_INPUT') {
    const text = userText(line.content);
    return text ? [finish(env('u', 'user_prompt', { text }), LIMITS.user_prompt, ctx)] : [];
  }
  if (line.type === 'PLANNER_RESPONSE') {
    const out = [];
    const text = typeof line.content === 'string' ? line.content.trim() : '';
    if (text) out.push(finish(env('a', 'assistant_text', { text }), LIMITS.assistant_text, ctx));
    (Array.isArray(line.tool_calls) ? line.tool_calls : []).forEach((call, i) => {
      const name = String((call && call.name) || 'unknown');
      const { text: t, paths } = describeTool(call && call.args, ctx);
      const isDenied = paths.some((p) => denied(p, ctx));
      pending.push(isDenied ? [name, 1] : [name]);
      if (!isDenied) out.push(finish(env('c' + i, 'tool_call', { tool: name, text: t }), LIMITS.tool_call, ctx));
    });
    return out;
  }
  if (line.type === 'GENERIC') {
    const known = pending.shift();
    if (known && known[1]) return [];
    const name = known ? known[0] : null;
    if (name && CONTENT_RESULT_TOOLS.has(name)) return [];
    let text = String(line.content || '').replace(/^Created At: .*\n(Completed At: .*\n)?/, '');
    const ok = line.status === 'DONE' ? true : line.status === 'ERROR' ? false : undefined;
    if (name && WRITE_TOOLS.has(name) && ok !== false) text = 'ok';
    const out = env('r', 'tool_result', { text });
    if (name) out.tool = name;
    if (ok !== undefined) out.ok = ok;
    return [finish(out, 0, ctx)];
  }
  return [];
}

module.exports = { normalize, discover, home, argValue };

```

// ~/.memo/status.json — what `memo status` reads without parsing the logs.
function writeStatus({ status, repos: lines, ms, cfg, error = null }) {
  const now = isoLocal();
  let prev = {};
  try { prev = readJson(statusPath(), {}) || {}; } catch (_) { prev = {}; }
  const failing = lines.filter((l) => !OK_CYCLE.includes(l.status));
  const next = {
    lastCycle: {
      ts: now, status, ms, repos: lines.length,
      calls: lines.reduce((n, l) => n + (Number(l.calls) || 0), 0),
      newEvents: lines.reduce((n, l) => n + (Number(l.newEvents) || 0), 0),
      committed: lines.filter((l) => l.committed).length
    },
    lastOk: status === 'ok' || status === 'paused' ? now : prev.lastOk || null,
    lastProcessed: lines.some((l) => (Number(l.jobs) || 0) > 0 && !l.mock) ? now : prev.lastProcessed || null,
    lastFailed: status === 'failed'
      ? { ts: now, reason: error || (failing[0] && (failing[0].status + (failing[0].error ? ': ' + failing[0].error : ''))) || 'failed' }
      : prev.lastFailed || null,
    nextExpected: isoLocal(Date.now() + Number(cfg.intervalMinutes || 15) * 60000)
  };
  try { writeJsonAtomic(statusPath(), next); } catch (_) { /* status is advisory only */ }
  return next;
}

function fmtLine(l) {
  const bits = [l.repo.padEnd(24), 'events ' + l.newEvents, 'jobs ' + l.jobs, 'calls ' + l.calls];
  if (l.committed) bits.push('commit ' + l.committed);
  bits.push(l.status);
  if (l.leftover) bits.push('backlog ' + l.leftover);
  if (l.error) bits.push('— ' + l.error);
  else if (l.note && l.status !== 'ok') bits.push('— ' + l.note);
  return '  ' + bits.join(' · ');
}

// Preloaded into every test process (npm test → node --require). Child `memo` processes inherit
// process.env, so no test can reach the real ~/.memo, ~/.claude/settings.json, the real
// scheduled task or the Windows key store, even if it forgets to set these itself.

const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

if (!process.env.MEMO_TEST_ISOLATED) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-test-isolated-'));
  process.env.MEMO_TEST_ISOLATED = base;
  process.env.MEMO_HOME = path.join(base, 'home');
  process.env.MEMO_CLAUDE_SETTINGS = path.join(base, 'claude-settings.json');
  process.env.MEMO_TASK_NAME = 'MEMO test task (never registered)';
  process.env.MEMO_FAKE_TASK = JSON.stringify({ exists: false });
  process.env.MEMO_SECRET_BACKEND = 'file';
  process.env.MEMO_SHIM_DIR = path.join(base, 'shim');
  process.env.MEMO_NO_PATH_EDIT = '1';
  for (const name of ['MEMO_API_KEY', 'GROQ_API_KEY', 'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', 'MEMO_MOCK_LLM']) delete process.env[name];
  process.on('exit', () => { try { fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) { /* best effort */ } });
}

'use strict';

// Gemini (Antigravity) conversations are matched to the repo by their first tool path.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync, spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const MEMO = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'bin', 'memo.js');
const SKIP = spawnSync('git', ['--version'], { windowsHide: true }).error && 'git not installed';
const SID = 'd4c4ea82-b31a-42ec-b131-f8dde9506265';

// Antigravity stores tool args as JSON-encoded strings.
const arg = (v) => JSON.stringify(v);

function setup(t) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'memo-gemini-test-'));
  const root = path.join(base, 'repo');
  const agHome = path.join(base, 'antigravity');
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  const env = { ...process.env, MEMO_HOME: path.join(base, 'home'), ANTIGRAVITY_HOME: agHome, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1' };
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root, windowsHide: true, env });
  const memo = (args) => spawnSync(process.execPath, [MEMO, ...args], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true, env });
  assert.equal(memo(['init']).status, 0);
  const conversation = (sid, steps) => {
    const dir = path.join(agHome, 'brain', sid, '.system_generated', 'logs');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'transcript.jsonl'), steps.map((s) => JSON.stringify(s)).join('\n') + '\n');
    return path.join(dir, 'transcript.jsonl');
  };
  return { base, root, memo, conversation };
}

- **Claude Code:** session shuru hote hi background mein `memo cycle` chal jaata hai. Agar pichhle 5 minute mein cycle chal chuka ho to skip ho jaata hai.
- **VS Code / Antigravity (Copilot aur Gemini):** `memo init` ab `.vscode/tasks.json` mein ek task jodta hai jo folder khulte hi `memo cycle` chalata hai.

  - Agar `tasks.json` pehle se hai to task usme jud jaata hai. Agar usme comments hain to file ko chhoda nahi jaata, sirf hint milta hai.
- Har cycle: sab agents ki nayi conversations save, unki summary, aur `AGENTS.md` / `copilot-instructions.md` / `GEMINI.md` refresh.
